it.name: Notability: AI Notes & Planner
it.d:
From your first lecture to your next big meeting, Notability helps you think, learn, and work better. Take handwritten notes, annotate documents, record audio, and stay organized in one place so your ideas are always clear, searchable, and ready when you need them.

NEW: NOTABILITY CLASSIC IS BACK
Prefer to pay one time for Notability? Our Classic plan is a one-time purchase with no subscription required.

FREE DIGITAL NOTES FOR WORK & SCHOOL
• Write, type, or sketch with digital ink, highlighters, and text tools.
• Mark up anything: PDFs, textbooks, lecture slides, images, and more.
• Combine handwriting, typed text, images, diagrams, and sketches on the same page.
• Stay organized with customizable folders and subjects that grow with you.

FOR PROFESSIONALS: WORK SMARTER AND SAVE TIME
• Mark up documents, capture meetings, organize ideas, and present with confidence.
• Import and handwrite on any document: PDFs, DOCs, presentations, reports, and more.
• Fill out forms in the office or on a job site.
• Combine handwriting, text, photos and documents in one place.
• Record calls and meetings to transcribe voice in real-time. Audio is synced to your notes so nothing is missed.
• Receive automated meeting notes, takeaways, and summaries.
• Search handwriting, transcripts, text, and PDFs to quickly revisit decisions and action items.
• Present notes, documents, and ideas in full screen, with a laser pointer to guide attention.
• View and edit two notes side-by-side to stay focused and productive.
• Share a PDF of your note in one tap.

FOR STUDENTS: STUDY SMARTER AND ACE EXAMS
• Take handwritten notes digitally or annotate lecture slides or your textbooks.
• Record lectures and get instant audio transcripts and real-time summaries in your notes.
• Audio recordings are synced to the exact moment you write in a note — perfect for lectures.
• Import lecture slides, textbook PDFs, and assignments into organized folders and subjects.
• Search across handwriting, typed notes, and transcripts to instantly find content from classes.
• Study content from your note with personalized quizzes and flashcards to practice with active recall.
• Chat with your notes to review concepts, clarify ideas, and prepare for exams.
 
WORK YOUR WAY
• Seamlessly switch between handwriting and typing.
• Import files instantly and keep everything connected.
• Share notes easily to collaborate or get feedback when needed.
• Access your notes across iPad, iPhone, Mac, and the web.
• Create beautiful notes using templates from the Notability Gallery.

UPGRADE TO A NOTABILITY SUBSCRIPTION
Notability is free to use. With an upgraded subscription, you can receive:
• Unlimited note-taking
• AI-powered productivity and study tools
• Handwriting recognition and math conversion
• Live Audio transcripts
• Auto-backup and iCloud sync

Download for free on iPad, iPhone, Mac, and web.
Privacy Policy: notability.com/privacy
Terms of Service: notability.com/terms

it.name: Documents - File Manager
it.d:
Documents by Readdle is your file manager, document viewer, PDF editor, and archive extractor for iPhone and iPad. Browse and organize your files, extract ZIP and RAR archives, edit and sign PDFs, and convert or compress anything — all from one app.

FILE MANAGER
- Browse, organize, and manage local files and folders in one fast file browser, rename and color-tag them for quick access
- Import files from your computer, download files directly from the web browser, or work with iCloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and other cloud drives without downloading them


ZIP & RAR ARCHIVE EXTRACTOR
- Unzip and extract ZIP and RAR archives directly on your iPhone or iPad
- Create new ZIP archives to compress and share multiple files at once
- Compress large files and folders to save storage space

PDF EDITOR, VIEWER & CONVERTER
- View and read PDFs, books, and scanned documents with a fast built-in viewer
- Edit or modify existing text directly inside a PDF
- Highlight, add notes, and place stickers on PDFs and books
- Merge multiple PDFs into one, or split, rotate, and reorder pages
- Convert PDF to Word, JPG, PNG, HEIC, and other formats

SIGN DOCUMENTS
- Add your signature to PDF contracts and forms in seconds
- Fill out forms and place text, checkmarks, and initials anywhere on a document
- Store signed contracts securely and access them from any device

FILE CONVERTER & COMPRESSOR
- Convert between PDF, DOCX, JPG, JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, and more in a few taps
- Compress PDFs, photos, and files to reduce size for email or upload limits
- Create PDFs from photos, scans, or documents, and convert them back to editable formats

SCANNER
- Scan receipts, books, and documents with a built-in OCR document scanner
- Save scans as searchable PDFs directly in Documents or your cloud drive

ALSO INSIDE
- Transcribe audio and video to text, then edit or export the transcript
- Use Smart Eraser to remove unwanted objects from photos
- Play music and video, and transfer files to your Mac or PC over Wi-Fi

Documents is an App Store Editors' Choice winner.

it.name: UpNote - notes, diary, journal
it.d:
UpNote is a clean and beautiful app for writing and organizing. It's easy to use with rich features and delightful experience.

UpNote is designed to help you take notes easily and stay focused on what matters most.

UpNote has beautiful fonts and elegant themes that you can adjust to make your writing experience most comfortable and pleasant.

UpNote is an ideal place to keep your diary and journal. It has a powerful lock feature so that you can rest assured that your notes stay private and secure. You can also use Touch ID or Face ID to securely unlock your notes.

UpNote’s intuitive organizing system will keep your note space neat and light. There are many ways to organize your notes: putting them into notebooks, pinning your notes to the top of the note list, bookmarking them for quick reference or linking to other notes. You can also close any notebooks to focus on only most important one.

UpNote’s rich editor makes it perfect for planning and managing your tasks. Simply write down your to-do list and have them synced to all your devices.

UpNote offers highlight, text colors, table, nested list, code and many other important formatting tools so that you could easily format your notes.

UpNote syncs notes instantly on all devices. It also works reliably offline, so you could take note anytime, anywhere.

If you are a markdown user, UpNote is great for you too. It has intuitive shortcuts based on markdown, which makes it more fun to write notes. You can also export your notes to Markdown or PDF.

Try UpNote now and you will fall in love with it!

----

Upgrade to Premium to get full power of UpNote:
- Lock your notes and notebooks
- Insert table and attachments
- Write unlimited number of notes
- Elegant themes and notebook covers
- Export to text PDF, HTML and Markdown

----

Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial peri​od will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

----

If you have any question or feedback, we would love to hear it. Send an email to support@getupnote.com, and we would love to get in touch with you!

----

Privacy policy: https://getupnote.com/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://getupnote.com/terms.html

it.name: Scan Hero: PDF Scanner
it.d:
Looking for a mobile assistant? Try the Scan Hero app to corral your paperwork and scan documents on the go! 
Scan Hero helps you run your business in the ever-changing digital world. Scan documents to PDF, then sign, edit, and share them – no heavy equipment needed! Manage paperwork hassle-free from anywhere – the office, remotely, or from home. Stay one step ahead when it comes to document management.

Loved by more than 29 million users.


SCAN DOCUMENTS
- Scan any document automatically or manually and save it as a PDF file or image.
- Try various Camera Modes to scan specific types of documents.
- Adjust the quality and file size of your scans: choose low, medium, or high quality.
- Import documents right from Photos for further editing and sharing.

TRY CAMERA MODES
- Single Mode captures a single page.
- Multi Mode scans two pages at once.
- Passport & ID Card Modes digitize your ID-documents. 
- Book Mode scans a two-page spread of a book.
- QR Mode reads QR codes with your device’s Camera.

MAKE EDITS
- Re-crop scans, change page perspective and borders, apply filters, adjust contrast, and correct or change the orientation.
- Organize and reorder pages in multipage documents.  

MANAGE SCANS
- Print scanned documents and clipboard text wirelessly.
- Share scans separately or send a number of files in one PDF file via Mail or iMessage.
- Save all your scans to Photos or iCloud and synchronize them between all of your iOS devices. 
- Protect your files with Face ID or passcode.

LEVEL UP WITH PREMIUM FEATURES
- Recognize and extract text from your scans with OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology. 
Available for texts in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Norwegian, Japanese, and Portuguese.
- Fine-tune scans by selecting HD quality while scanning.
- Sign scans right on the screen of your device. Create and save one or more signatures, and add them to scans whenever you need.
- Highlight the key points of your scans.
- Secure private information in scanned documents using the Hide tool.
- Scan and share without limits.

*For advanced editing and file management, you can also try our PDF Hero app!

Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. 
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.

Privacy Policy: https://support.bendingspoons.com/privacy.html?app=1017261655
Terms of Service: https://support.bendingspoons.com/tos.html?app=1017261655

Got questions or suggestions? Please don’t hesitate to email us at support@scanhero.app

it.name: Calendars: Schedule Planner
it.d:
Calendars by Readdle is the all-in-one calendar, task manager, daily planner, and habit tracker — seamlessly working across all your Apple devices: Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
Plan your day, build better habits, boost productivity, and stay organized with powerful features and smooth sync between all your devices.
What you can do with Calendars:
 • View and manage your calendar with daily, weekly, and monthly views
 • Create events, set reminders, and never miss important dates
 • Use the built-in agenda planner to focus on what matters most
 • Organize your to-do list and manage your tasks with ease
 • Quickly add events or to-do items using natural language
 • Build routines and track your habits to stay consistent
 • Take a guided productivity course to improve time management and focus
 • Sync across devices with Google Calendar, iCloud, and more
 • Customize your planner calendar with color coding and widgets
 • Join Zoom, Google Meet, or GoToMeeting directly from your calendar
 • Stay in control of your time, wherever you are
Whether you're planning a busy workday, building new habits, or working on personal growth, Calendars brings everything together to help you own your time — across all your Apple devices.

it.name: Minutes: AI Meeting Note Taker
it.d:
Minutes AI automatically does your meeting notes and transcriptions with AI. Minutes records audio and provides word for word transcripts with speakers labels. Then, it gives you formatted notes, summaries, and the ability to search for key terms/topics. You can ask questions like “What stats did Laura reference on her slide?.”
 
Minutes takes care of your notes so you can stay focused on what’s important. It's build with privacy in mind, meaning Minutes will never sell or provide third-party access to your data.

Minutes is great for:
- Taking meeting notes automatically, and easily sharing with your coworkers
- Recording and transcribing interviews, lectures, podcasts, videos, YouTube videos, webinars, keynotes
- Providing live captioning to the deaf and managers with a quiet microphone

Record & Transcribe Live
- Start recording with one click
- Specify keywords (uncommon words, terms, acronyms, names, etc.) for Minutes AI to listen for
- Specify transcription and summary languages (eg transcribe in Spanish, take notes in English)
- Get a highly accurate live transcription with labeled speakers
- See a list of key points to review later
- Ask questions and chat with the recording using AI

AI Notes Formatting
- Automatic punctuation, capitalization, and line breaks
- Search for important words from the audio
- Edit the text to fix any mistakes

Terms of Use: https://legal.myminutes.ai/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://legal.myminutes.ai/privacy-policy

it.name: iTranslate Translator
it.d:
iTranslate is one of the leading translation and dictionary apps designed to help you break language barriers with ease. Seamlessly translate text, websites, objects, or start voice-to-voice conversations in over 100 languages. Our unique Custom Phrasebook feature allows you to learn new languages and create personalized collections of phrases for various life situations. And if you need to use iTranslate abroad, our Offline Mode allows you to forget about paying expensive roaming charges. 

FEATURES:
• Text translations in over 100 languages. 
• Phrasebook - with over 250 predefined phrases.
• Different dialects available.
• Dictionaries with synonyms and different meanings.
• Widgets & Flashcards: Learn a new phrase or word each day, directly from your home screen!
• Pronunciation in male or female voices. 
• Transliteration, Sharing, Favorites, History, and much more.

• Custom Phrasebook - to create your own collection of phrases.
• Keyboard Extension.
• Lens: Use your camera to instantly translate menus or signs and more.
• AR Mode for Real-time Object Translation
• Offline translation mode. 
• Voice-to-Voice conversations.
• Website translation
• Verb conjugations in different tenses.

LOVED AND TRUSTED BY MILLIONS
• 200 million downloads and over 1 million App Store reviews!
• Featured many times in Apple TV ads and on the App Store

SUPPORT
Visit https://www.itranslate.com/support/ or contact us at help@itranslate.com

Supported languages & dialects for translation:
Afrikaans, Albanian, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Cebuano, Chichewa, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Esperanto, Estonian, Filipino, Finnish, French, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Igbo, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Korean, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Mongolian, Myanmar (Burmese), Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Sesotho, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Tajik, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Yiddish, Yoruba, Zulu

---
Auto Renewable Subscription Terms:
* Your free trial subscription will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period. 
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
* You can cancel a free trial or subscription anytime by turning off auto-renewal through your iTunes account settings. This must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to the free service.
* Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

it.d:
TeraBox: Your Personal All-in-One AI Assistant with 1024GB of FREE Cloud Storage!

TeraBox is more than just cloud storage — it’s your smart AI assistant. Store, organize, and share large files in seconds, then let AI help you search for anything, make stunning photos and videos, and unlock handy smart tools. Register now to get 1024GB of free cloud storage and explore endless possibilities with AI!

KEY FEATURES
[NEW] Tera AI: All-in-One AI Agent
Ask anything and get real answers. Turn photos into highlight reels, posters, and cards in a tap. Summarize a long PDF or pull the key details out of a screenshot. Search, create, and get things done — all in one place, without leaving the app.

[NEW] AI Study: Turn Files into Notes & Quizzes
AI Study turns anything you save into something you actually learn. Drop in a file and get clear structured notes in seconds — or record a lecture or meeting live and let AI listen and take the notes for you. Then quiz yourself, review with flashcards, and see how the ideas connect on a mind map. Less time organizing, more time understanding.

Automatic Data Backup
Automatically back up your photos, videos, documents and even folders to TeraBox cloud storage. Keep everything synchronized and accessible from any mobile device or computer — wherever you are.

Ultra-Large File Transfer
Upload, store, and share big files up to 128 GB seamlessly. Whether you need to send big video files, massive document archives, or high-res media, TeraBox supports big file sharing quickly with a secure link. No size limits holding you back.

AI-Powered Search
Built-in AI browser lets you search smarter instantly. Quickly find what you need, watch trending videos, discover the latest movies, or follow hot topics—all within TeraBox. Search, browse, and watch, all in one place.

AI Image Creation & Editing
Transform your photos into AI art with just one tap. Try creative AI styles like Snoopy, Miyazaki, or Cyberpunk, or enhance your portraits with built-in beauty effects.

AI Video Generation
Turn your ideas or photos into creative videos in seconds. Choose from a variety of dynamic effects to quickly generate viral videos for social media, promos, or personal projects.

AI Transcription
Convert voice to text. Record live and see the transcript appear as you speak, or upload any audio or video file. Get accurate, readable transcripts with key points summarized automatically — saving you hours of manual note-taking.

HD Video Player + AI Subtitles
Enjoy smooth, high-definition video playback within TeraBox. Our AI automatically generates accurate subtitles for lectures, foreign films, or personal videos, making it easier to follow and understand every word.

AI Scanning & PDF Document Management
Quickly scan multiple documents and edit your PDFs easily. TeraBox automatically recognizes text, helping you organize and clean up digital files.

Other Advanced AI Tools
Explore more built-in AI features such as AI Sketch, handwriting removal, translation, and image compression. TeraBox is your ultimate AI toolbox for every daily need.


HIGHLIGHTS
- 1024GB Free Storage: Safely back up millions of photos, videos, and documents.
- Large File Uploads & Sharing: Easily send big files to anyone via secure links.
- Privacy Protection: Advanced encryption keeps all your files safe.
- Multi-Device Sync: Access and sync all your files from any computer, tablet, or mobile phone.
- Intelligent Albums: Auto-categorize your photos for quick and easy browsing.

Sign up for TeraBox now to get 1TB of free cloud storage and enjoy a powerful portable AI assistant!

SUPPORT
Any questions or support? Please contact us at helpdesk@terabox.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.terabox.com/terms/privacy?lang=en
Terms of Use: https://www.terabox.com/terms/duty?lang=en

it.name: Tarteel: AI Quran Memorization
it.d:
Join 15+ million Muslims strengthening their relationship with the Quran.

Tarteel is the leading AI-powered Quran companion designed to help you memorize, read, and review with confidence. Whether you are a student of Hifz or someone looking to improve their daily recitation, Tarteel adapts to your journey.

THE #1 AI QURAN COMPANION
Simply hide the verses and recite; Tarteel uses industry-leading recognition accuracy to track your voice and reveal the words on the screen as you recite them. It’s not just about reading—it’s about verifying your memorization instantly.

REINFORCE YOUR MEMORIZATION
• Memorization Mistake Detection: Hide the verses on the mushaf and recite from memory. Tarteel’s AI listens to your recitation and flags word-level errors, skipped words, or incorrect tashkeel instantly.
• Recite Anywhere, Anytime: Whether you are in the car, walking to work, or whispering in a quiet room, Tarteel follows your recitation. No need to wait for a revision partner. Your Quran companion is always ready.
• Live Correction: Tap on any highlighted mistake to see exactly what you recited versus the correct Ayah. Build confidence before your next class.

PLAN, TRACK & IMPROVE
• Smart Goals: Set custom targets for memorization, revision, or reading (e.g., "Surah Al-Kahf every Friday" or "Review Juz 30").
• Advanced Analytics: Visualize your progress with streaks and heatmaps. See which Surahs are strong and which Ayahs need more work.
• Unlimited Listening: Listen to your favorite Qaris to perfect your pronunciation and rhythm. Follow along with the text or listen in the background—completely free.

KEY FEATURES
• Voice Search: "Shazam for Quran"—recite any phrase, and Tarteel will instantly find the specific Ayah and Surah.
• Adaptive Mushaf: Choose between Madani or Indo-Pak scripts, with options to hide Ayah markers for a true test of memory.
• Historical Mistakes: Review a log of your past recitation errors to identify patterns and weak spots in your Hifz.
• Privacy First: Tarteel does not sell your data. We operate with Ihsan, prioritizing user privacy and experience.

TARTEEL PREMIUM
While recitation follow-along, listening, and voice search are free, Tarteel Premium unlocks the full power of AI. Start your FREE TRIAL to access:
• Live Memorization Mistake Detection
• Peeking & Hidden Verses Mode
• Goal Planning & Advanced Analytics
• Historical Mistake Tracking

Join the global community of Muslims using Tarteel. Memorize smarter, stay consistent, and correct your recitation instantly.

—

NOTES:
Tarteel requires microphone access and a stable internet connection in order for its voice features to function properly. Please ensure you allow Tarteel to access these permissions on your device.

Privacy Policy: https://www.tarteel.ai/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://www.tarteel.ai/terms/

it.name: Drafts
it.d:
Drafts is where text starts. Quickly capture text and send it almost anywhere!

Drafts turns text into action with almost limitless possibilities – it’s a quick notebook, handy editor, and writing automation tool, all in one. Capture all of your text in Drafts and send it to other apps without the extra taps. Just open it and start typing!

**Drafts is a multi-award winner!**

- App of the Day, TIME Magazine’s Best Apps
- MacStories “Lifetime Acheivement” and “Reader’s Choice” Awards

## WHY YOU’LL LOVE DRAFTS ##

CAPTURE EVERYWHERE:
Drafts opens to a new page with the keyboard ready — just waiting for your words. Alternatively, go hands-free with dictation.

Drafts helps you write ideas down before you can forget them so and they’ll always be there, ready and waiting. Capture on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch, and Drafts’ fast sync will make your text available everywhere.

USE YOUR WORDS:
Drafts is a jumping-off point for text — use actions to copy it, share it, or deep-link into other apps and services. Compose a tweet, draft a message, create a file in Dropbox, send a task off to Reminders – Drafts works with tons of your favorite apps and services. Hone your text through integrations with popular AI LLMs.

REMEMBER IT NOW – OR LATER:
New entries go into the Inbox. Once there, you can Tag them for organization, Flag them for importance, or Archive them for long-term storage.

TAKE TEXT TO A NEW LEVEL:
Customize Drafts to look and work the way you want with tons of interface adjustments — custom fonts and control over spacing, line height, and margins.

Use the customizable buttons above the keyboard to convert, manipulate, and transform your writing quickly.

Using Drafts as a global inbox for all of your text? Process everything quickly using unique features like Link Mode, Arrange Mode, and text manipulation actions.

LEVERAGE THE POWER OF YOUR WRIST COMPUTER:
Use your Apple Watch to quickly capture text using nothing more than your voice — and your ideas will be waiting on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac ready to be fleshed out.

GETTING WORDS DOWN HAS NEVER BEEN EASIER:
Drafts opens lightning fast and with support for capture via Siri, the widget, share extension, file import, and dictation - Drafts is like post-its updated for the smartphone era.


## JOIN THE COMMUNITY ##

Check out our Directory (actions.getdrafts.com) for ready-to-use actions and themes. Join the Drafts Community (forums.getdrafts.com) to get help, integration guides, and a regular flow of tips & tricks.


## DRAFTS PRO ##

Drafts is always free to use, but you can get more out of Drafts with a Drafts Pro subscription:

• Create and Edit Actions
• Themes and Icons - suit the experience to your tastes with themes, custom app icons, and more
• Workspaces - Apply preferred tag, query, and sort settings for your drafts list with Workspaces
• Extra widgets and better share extension options
• Enhanced Automation

We are always working hard to expand the capabilities of Drafts and keep it up-to-date with the latest technologies. Your support helps keep the app growing – thank you to Drafts Pro subscribers!


## SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS ##

• Monthly and annual subscriptions are available
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
• Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is disabled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period
• Automatic renewals will be charged at the same price you were originally charged for the subscription
• Subscriptions can be managed or canceled by going to Account Settings on the App Store after purchase

Have questions? Contact us on Twitter at @draftsapp or email support@getdrafts.com.

Terms: https://getdrafts.com/support/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getdrafts.com/support/privacy

it.name: Noteshelf: AI Notes & PDF
it.d:
Write. Plan. Study. Work. Create.

Noteshelf 3 brings natural handwriting, powerful AI, PDF annotation, audio recording and planning together in one beautiful app for iPad, iPhone and Mac. Free to start.

FOR STUDENTS
• Take lecture and class notes with lifelike pens, pencils and highlighters
• Annotate textbooks, worksheets, slides and PDFs
• Record audio while you write, so you never miss a word
• Use Noteshelf AI to summarize and explain what you've learned

FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Capture meeting notes and record important discussions
• Mark up contracts, reports and presentations
• Present your notes on an external display with a laser pointer

CollaNote: Powerful note-taking app packed with a wide range of tools.
Note-taking, PDF markup, digital planning, and flashcards - all in one place!

- 25+ different pens and brushes to transform your notes into artwork.

it.name: MyScript Notes: AI Handwriting
it.d:
Create stunning notes and professional documents effortlessly by hand, brainstorm ideas on an infinite canvas, and annotate PDFs seamlessly. Powered by the world's leading AI handwriting recognition technology, MyScript Notes offers a dynamic platform where handwriting, text, drawings, diagrams, and images seamlessly coexist on an expandable canvas. Enhance your note-taking experience with intuitive pen gestures, effortlessly converting handwriting and shapes into typed text and precise forms.

MyScript Notes understands every word you write in your choice of 66 languages, and works on mobile platforms — so you can access and search your notes from any compatible device.

Enjoy 4 powerful experiences in one app:

• Create unlimited notebooks and fixed-size pages for your daily notes.
• Take freeform notes on boards — the world's most advanced endless canvas.
• Handwrite responsive documents, adding math calculations and diagrams.
• Import existing files as PDFs, ready to annotate.

Start with a 7-day free trial to get the full experience — then choose to upgrade to keep all features, or continue with a free limited version.

————————

DIGITAL HANDWRITING
• Write¹, type or dictate in the same page, sentence or even word.
• Accurately convert handwriting and math to typed text, and drawn diagrams to perfect shapes. Diagrams stay editable when pasted into PowerPoint!
• Write emoji and symbols with your pen.
• Highlight ideas live with a glowing laser pointer — no marks left behind.
• Draw straight lines with the ruler — drag, rotate and snap it into place to draw at any angle.

EDIT WITH YOUR PEN
• Use intuitive gestures to edit and format content without breaking your flow.
• Use the marker to highlight or color, the lasso to select, and the eraser to delete entire strokes or precisely defined content.

WRITE, TYPE AND DRAW FREELY ON A BOARD
• Enjoy an infinite canvas, ideal for brainstorming, mind mapping and freeform note-taking.
• Pan around and zoom in or out for a fresh perspective.
• Use the lasso to select, move, copy, delete or resize content — and to convert handwriting to typed text.

SWITCH TO A DOCUMENT FOR A RESPONSIVE EXPERIENCE
• Create and edit structured notes — your handwriting will automatically reflow as needed.
• Make edits, adjust layout, rotate your device or split your screen without worrying about readability.

ENRICH YOUR NOTES
• Personalize content using a range of pen types and page backgrounds.
• Add photos, sketches and smart objects like math and diagrams.
• Handwrite math equations and matrices across several lines, solve simple calculations and copy math as LaTeX or image.

————————

MyScript Notes respects your privacy and never stores content on our servers without your explicit consent.

For help or feature requests, create a ticket at https://myscri.pt/support
Check out MyScript Notes' webpage for more information about cross-platform: https://www.myscript.com/notes

————————

¹You can use any compatible active or passive pen, including Apple Pencil, to write in MyScript Notes. Check minimum and recommended requirements for MyScript Notes: https://myscri.pt/notes-devices

it.name: TickTick:To-Do List & Calendar
it.d:
TickTick is a powerful to-do list and task management app with seamless cloud sync across all your devices. Whether you need to plan your schedule, take notes, share shopping lists, collaborate with your team, build new habits, or set countdowns for birthdays, TickTick helps you get things done and keep life on track.

Key features of TickTick:
- Sync tasks across all devices
- Multiple reminders
- Flexible calendar views
- Calendar integrations
- Flexible recurring tasks
- Create checklists
- Four priority levels
- Share task lists for collaboration
- Add tasks via email
- Upload attachments to tasks
- Organize tasks with tags
- Track birthdays and anniversaries with countdowns
- Plan and organize tasks with the AI Assistant

More functions to help you stay focused and boost productivity:
- Use Siri to create tasks more quickly and easily
- Use the Pomo Timer to stay focused
- Set goals to build habits
- Add tasks by voice with AI
- TickTick MCP
- Reminders based on time or location
- Sort tasks by order, date, title, or priority
- Add descriptions/comments to tasks
- Batch edit tasks
- Quickly search for tasks

TickTick is always free, but you can also upgrade to a Premium account to enjoy full access to the most advanced features:
- More lists and tasks: 299 lists, 999 tasks in each list, 199 checklist items in each task
- Add up to 5 reminders to each task
- Share a task list with up to 29 members for better collaboration
- Upload up to 199 attachments every day
- Subscribe to calendars in TickTick
- Full access to calendar views
- Custom Smart Lists
- Track up to 299 habits
- Create up to 299 countdowns

How does TickTick help you be more productive?
- Get things done
- Stay on top of your schedule
- Collaborate more efficiently
- Sync across multiple platforms
- Save time and energy for what matters most

Premium subscription billing:
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account when your purchase is confirmed. Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn off automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
If you already have Premium through another platform, we recommend waiting until your current Premium access expires before starting a new subscription. Turn off automatic renewal on your existing subscription if needed.

TickTick integrates with HealthKit, allowing you to sync your focus time data with Apple Health.

Our Privacy Policy: https://www.ticktick.com/about/privacy
Our Terms of Use: https://www.ticktick.com/about/tos

For questions, feedback, or tips, we're happy to help you at support@ticktick.com

Connect with us:
X (Twitter): @ticktickteam
Instagram: @ticktickapp
Facebook: @TickTickApp
Reddit: r/ticktick

it.d:
The most intelligent scanner app
Trusted by 300M+ users

CamScanner is an all-in-one scanner app. It turns your mobile device into a powerful portable scanner that recognizes text automatically (OCR) and improves your productivity to save your time. Download this scanner app for free to instantly scan, save, and share any document in PDF, JPG, Word, or TXT formats.
Would you like to keep your entire office in your pocket and increase your productivity at work? Use the CamScanner scanner app to handle your paperwork with ease. Say goodbye to huge and heavy copy machines and get this ultra-fast scanner app for free now.

DOCUMENT SCANNER
This free-of-charge yet powerful scanner app is a must-have for students and anyone involved in business: accountants, realtors, managers, or lawyers. With this PDF scanner, scan anything you need, receipts, contracts, paper notes, fax papers, books, and store your scans as multipage PDF or JPG files.

VARIOUS SCANNING MODES
–ID CARD & PASSPORT: A mode specifically designed for fast and convenient scans of ID documents.
–QR CODE: Scan any QR code with the camera on your mobile device.

PDF CONVERTER
–PDF Converter: This PDF scanner enables you to create PDF from a website, and convert documents in multiple formats to PDF.
–Supported file formats: PDF, JPG, DOC, DOCX, TXT, XLS, XLSM, XLSX, CVS, PPT, PPTM, PPTX.

SHARE AND COLLABORATE
–Share files for commenting or viewing in WhatsApp, iMessage, Microsoft Teams.
–Collect comments from multiple people in one file online.
–Speed document reviews by responding to each other's comments.
–Receive activity notifications for the files you share.

INNOVATIVE PDF SCANNER
–Scan documents and photos to PDF, JPG, or TXT.
–Easily scan multiple pages into one document.
–Extract text from any scannable object with text recognition (OCR).
–Create and add your own e-signature on documents.

HANDY DOCUMENT EDITOR & FILE MANAGER
–Edit scans with filters and the feature of noise removal.
–Manage files with folders, drag & drop to reorder, and enjoy other document editing features.
–Protect your confidential scans by locking folders and files with passwords.

EASILY SEND DOCUMENT
–Scan, save and send documents in just a few taps.
–Email with attachments or send document links.
–Upload scanned documents to cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, Evernote, and OneDrive.
–Print PDF files, such as contracts and invoices, right from the scanner app.
–Send files quickly and securely. Scanning or sharing is achieved with no intervention from the CamScanner scanner app team or any third party. Documents are safely stored on your mobile devices.

UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
–You can subscribe to get unlimited access to all features of the scanner app.
–Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan.
–Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
–Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
–Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
–Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
–Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.

it.name: Shapr 3D CAD modeling
it.d:
From design to manufacturing. Teams collaborate with more impact. Instinctive design meets multidevice capability and full interoperability for the ultimate 3D design workflow.

All platforms
Pick your device and your input tool leveraging the first CAD tool envisioned for multidevice. Hybrid workflow meets cross-functional team processes with automatic sync across devices. Work from any device or offline: design and collaborate at your best, everywhere.

Compact tools. Space for focus.
An adaptive user interface auto-sorts tools, taking the clutter out of designing. Your focus stays front and center to eliminate clunking around and prioritize high-quality decisions.

Design-driven collaboration.
Make designing a reflex and visual communication second nature for the whole team. Instinctive CAD meets a visual communication bundle complete with real-time 3D renders in AR, shareable via a link for download-free viewing. Start where you are and finish strong – no expensive hardware needed.

Shapr3D combines industrial-grade CAD with a user-friendly experience, including:
• Siemens™ geometric Parasolid® modeling kernel and D-Cubed™ sketch engine
• Export support for X_T, STEP, STL, OBJ, 2D DXF, 2D DWG, IGES, 3MF, SVG
• Import support for SLDPRT, SLDASM, X_T, STEP, STL, IGES, 2D DWG, 2D DXF, JPG, PNG
• Output 2D Drawings

Get in touch
Have a question? Visit our forum: https://discourse.shapr3d.com.

it.name: Scanner Pro - Scan to PDF
it.d:
Scanner Pro is a professional document scanner that turns your iPhone or iPad into a portable scan-to-PDF tool. Scan agreements, receipts, IDs, books, and more — Scanner Pro automatically detects borders, corrects perspective, and removes shadows to produce clean, ready-to-share PDFs in seconds.

DOCUMENT SCANNER
- Scan documents, receipts, pictures, IDs, books, and photos with automatic edge detection and perspective correction
- Digitize and restore old photos in color, black & white, or grayscale
- Highlight, write, and draw directly on your scanned documents

CONVERT & EXPORT
- Convert any scan into a searchable PDF in seconds
- Export scans as PDF, Word, PowerPoint, or JPG
- Merge multiple pages into a single PDF document
- Add a password to protect sensitive PDFs, or remove one when no longer needed

SIGN DOCUMENTS
- Add your signature to any scanned document or PDF in seconds
- Fill out forms and place text, checkmarks, and initials anywhere on a document
- Send signed documents directly by email or to any app

OCR & FULL-TEXT SEARCH
- Turn scanned text into editable text with built-in OCR
- Search across the text inside your scans instantly
- Highlight important sections and copy text directly from your scans

QR CODE SCANNER
- Scan and decode QR codes instantly from the camera screen — point, capture, done

SHARE & SYNC
- Access every scan on all your devices with iCloud sync
- Automatically export and upload scans to Dropbox, Evernote, Google Drive, Box, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, OneNote, or any WebDAV-enabled storage
- Share unlimited scans by email or with any app, completely free
- Translate scanned text into other languages

You can also fax documents directly from your device.

Scanner Pro supports 25+ languages, including English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, Japanese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

Download Scanner Pro today for a fast, professional way to scan, organize, and share documents wherever you are.

Share your feedback and comments at http://readdle.com/contact

it.name: WPS Office-AI Doc, PDF, Sheet
it.d:
One app for Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF. Work faster with AI and familiar tools, with files synced across phones, tablets, and computers.
Scan, convert, sign, and share documents wherever you work. WPS AI helps you summarize files, analyze content, and create presentations faster.

ALL YOUR DOCUMENTS, ONE WPS
• Documents: Create, read, and edit Word-compatible files with familiar formatting tools.
• Spreadsheets: View and edit Excel-compatible spreadsheets wherever you work.
• Presentations: Create, review, and update PowerPoint-compatible presentations.
• File Compatibility: Work with common Office and PDF formats without switching between multiple apps.

PDF TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY WORK
• Read & Edit: View, annotate, fill, sign, and organize PDF files.
• Convert: Convert supported Office files to PDF for easier sharing and delivery.
• Work on the Go: Review and update PDFs directly from your phone or tablet.

SCAN, EXTRACT, AND DIGITIZE
• Document Scanner: Scan documents, receipts, notes, and business cards.
• Advanced OCR: Extract text from images and scanned documents for editing and reuse.
• Image Enhancement: Improve scan clarity and reduce blur, shadows, and unwanted marks.

WORK ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
• Pick Up Anywhere: Access and edit your files across phones, tablets, and computers.
• Keep Files in Sync: Continue working across devices without repeatedly sending files to yourself.
• One Familiar Workspace: Manage your Office documents and PDFs with WPS wherever you work.

WPS AI: GET DOCUMENT WORK DONE FASTER
• Ask & Analyze: Find key information in lengthy PDFs, documents, and complex spreadsheets.
• Summarize: Turn long files and reports into concise takeaways.
• Write & Rewrite: Draft, rewrite, and polish emails, reports, and other content.
• Translate: Understand and work with content across languages.

AI SLIDES: FROM IDEA TO EDITABLE PRESENTATION
• Create from a Prompt: Turn a topic or outline into a structured presentation.
• Smart Layout: Let AI organize and format your slides.
• Continue Editing: Refine the generated content and layout before sharing.

SUPPORTED OFFICE FILE FORMATS
• 51 languages supported worldwide.
• Supports a wide range of office and development file formats:

DOC, DOCX, WPT, DOTM, DOCM, DOT, DOTX
XLS, XLSX, XLT, XLTX, CSV, XML, ET, ETT
PDF
PPT, POT, DPS, DPT, PPTX, POTX, PPSX
TXT
LOG, LRC, C, CPP, H, ASM, S, JAVA, ASP, BAT, BAS, PRG, CMD
ZIP

OPTIMIZED FOR iOS PERFORMANCE
• Engineered for fast and stable mobile performance.
• Designed to reduce lag during demanding document tasks.

AUTO-RENEW SUBSCRIPTION
Choose from 1-month, 3-month, or 1-year auto-renewal options. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or turn off auto-renewal anytime in your Apple ID account settings. Cancellations will take effect after the current active subscription period ends.

PRIVACY & TERMS

Auto-Renew Terms: https://www.wps.com/auto-renewal-terms/

it.name: Habit Tracker - HabitKit
it.d:
Big life changes do not start big. They start with one small habit, done today, done again tomorrow. HabitKit turns those daily wins into a colorful grid of tiles, one square for every day you show up, so you can finally see yourself becoming the person you want to be.

That visible progress is the whole secret behind HabitKit, a beautifully simple habit tracker. When your grid looks this good, you will not want to stop. Fill the tiles, protect your streak, and let consistency do the heavy lifting.

Whether you want to work out more, read every night, meditate, drink more water, save money, or finally quit smoking, HabitKit gives every goal the same simple loop: do it, log it, watch the grid grow. No guilt trips, just daily habit tracking that feels rewarding.

BUILD GOOD HABITS, QUIT BAD ONES
Create the habits you want to grow, or flip it around and quit a habit: every day counts as clean until you log a slip, and your streak counts your clean days in a row. You can even set a daily maximum, like two coffees a day, and simply stay under it instead of going cold turkey.

TRACK YOUR HABITS YOUR WAY
Check a day off with a simple yes or no, count reps like glasses or pages, or measure amounts with your own unit, like 2 L of water or 7.5 km of running. Set daily goals and flexible schedules that fit your routine: every day, specific intervals, or a number of times per week or month.

YOUR PROGRESS AT A GLANCE
Every habit gets its own tile grid, like a contribution graph, and every completed day fills in a square. See all your habits together on one dashboard, switch between Classic, Compact, and Split views, and share a beautiful snapshot of your progress when you hit a milestone. One glance tells you the whole story: what you did, what you missed, and how far you have come.

WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Put your favorite habits right on your home screen with small, medium, and multi-habit widgets. Your grids stay in sight, so your goals stay on your mind. Widgets follow your theme too, all the way to pure black dark mode.

REMINDERS AT THE RIGHT TIME
Get a friendly nudge exactly when you need it, and never forget a habit again. Add a daily check-in to review your whole day, and with Pro, up to three reminders per habit.

STATISTICS, STREAKS, AND NOTES
Watch your current streak grow, chase your best streak, and set streak goals for extra motivation. Dive into completion statistics and monthly charts, manage past days in the calendar, and add a short note to any day: what went well, what got in the way.

MAKE IT YOURS
Give every habit its own color and icon, or use any emoji. Organize your dashboard with categories and filters, reorder everything with drag and drop, and pick light, dark, or system theme, including a pure black mode for OLED screens.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. No ads. Your habit data stays on your device, and the app works completely offline.

HABITKIT PRO
HabitKit is free to use with up to four habits, including streaks, the calendar, notes, reminders, and exporting and importing backups. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, charts and statistics, home screen widgets, restoring archived habits, and up to three reminders per habit. Subscribe monthly or yearly, or pay once and keep Pro forever with the lifetime option. Every upgrade supports an independent developer. Start free, see if the grid pulls you in, and upgrade whenever you are ready.

You do not need a new life. You need one small habit and a place to see it grow. Download HabitKit and place your first tile today.

Terms of Use: https://www.habitkit.app/tos/
Privacy Policy: https://www.habitkit.app/privacy/

it.name: PDF Expert: Editor & Reader
it.d:
PDF Expert is a fast and easy PDF app to read, annotate, fill and sign PDF forms, convert files to PDF, and merge, split or compress documents – all in one intuitive app for iPhone, iPad, Mac & Vision Pro.

Read PDF files with comfort, highlight and mark up text, fill out forms, sign contracts, create and convert PDFs, and summarize long documents in seconds with AI-powered tools. Unlock unlimited possibilities with PDF Expert Premium and work across all your Apple devices.

"PDF Expert is one of my must-have iPad apps and a desktop-class PDF reader." – MacStories
"The best app for managing, editing, and reading PDFs on your iPad." – The Sweet Setup


▶ WITH PDF EXPERT, YOU CAN:

READ PDFs
- PDF reader with Day, Night, and Sepia modes for comfortable reading anytime
- Scroll PDFs vertically or horizontally and search text in any document
- Open and view PDF files from email, web, Files, or any app via the Share menu
- Read PDFs out loud with Text to Speech

ANNOTATE AND MARK UP PDFs
- Highlight, underline, and strike through text in your PDFs
- Mark up documents with pen, shapes, text, notes, and comments
- Add stamps such as Approved or Confidential
- Record your voice and add audio notes to PDFs

FILL AND SIGN PDF FORMS
- Fill out PDF forms with text fields, checkboxes, and radio buttons
- Sign PDF documents in seconds – draw your signature or add it from an image
- Save your signature to sign contracts, agreements, invoices, and applications faster
- Fill, sign, and send forms right from your iPhone – no printing or scanning needed
- Supports all major form formats, including AcroForms and static XFA forms

***PREMIUM FEATURES***

EDIT PDFs
- Edit text directly in a PDF – just as you would in a Word document
- Add, replace, and resize images in your PDFs
- Add links to other pages or websites
- Add outlines to navigate large PDFs

CREATE AND CONVERT PDFs
- Create PDFs from Word files, images, and other documents
- Convert Word to PDF, JPG to PDF, and PNG to PDF in seconds
- Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, and TXT

MERGE, SPLIT AND ORGANIZE PDFs
- Merge and combine multiple PDF files into one
- Split PDFs and extract pages into a new file
- Add, delete, rotate, and reorder pages with thumbnail preview

COMPRESS PDFs
- Compress PDFs to reduce file size for email and sharing
- Shrink large PDF files to save space on your device

SUMMARIZE PDFs WITH AI – PDF COPILOT
- List Main Points – get key takeaways from any PDF
- Summarize – get concise summaries of entire PDFs or annotations
- Ask Anything – find details with AI answers and references
- Explain – get instant explanations of words or phrases

PROTECT YOUR FILES
- Password-protect PDF Expert
- Redact – permanently black out sensitive information

WORK WITH SCANNED DOCUMENTS
- Open scanned PDFs to fill out, sign, annotate, and share

CONSTRUCTION TOOLS
- Scale and measure drawings with the Measure tab
- Polygon, polyline, and redline tools

MORE FEATURES
- Customizable toolbar
- Presentation Mode
- Print and share PDFs via email or cloud

ONE ACCOUNT FOR ALL YOUR APPLE DEVICES
One Premium subscription covers PDF Expert on iPhone, iPad, and Mac – no need to buy versions separately.


Read more about our terms and conditions here:
https://pdfexpert.com/privacy
https://pdfexpert.com/terms

Don’t hesitate to reach out to us at http://readdle.com/contact

Mobile Scanner is a free-to-download and all-in-one scanner app. Scan any documents, paper notes, photos, receipts, and books into clear PDFs and pictures. Convert images into text with OCR technology and export searchable PDF files.
Get the Mobile Scanner app now and turn your phone into a powerful digital office.

Ultra-fast Scanning
 - Scan anything - receipts, pictures, notes, business cards, contracts, fax papers, and books with precision and turn them into PDF, Word, or JPEG files.
 - Batch scanning - scan as many as you like and save the files as one PDF.

Smart Image Optimizing:
 - Automatic border detection and cropping.
 - Preview, crop, rotate, adjust color and resize the PDF or photos you scan.
 - Remove and edit imperfections, erase stains, marks, creases, and handwriting.
 - Sign your scans manually or add signatures for the document.
 - Generate perfect quality docs with advanced picture processing filters.

Text Extracting & Editing
 - Built-in OCR (optical character recognition) technology to recognize any text from your scans.
 - Edit the text as you want.
 - Export texts as TXT.

Organize & Share Files
 - Organize your files with custom folders, drag & drop to reorder.
 - Share documents by email attachments.
 - Upload scanned files to cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, and OneDrive.
 - Print PDF files, such as contracts and invoices, right from the scanner app.

Secure Important Documents
 - Ensure privacy by setting passwords to lock confidential documents and folders. 
 - Keep all your personal information like contracts, bank cards, and tax documents secure.

Download the free Mobile Scanner app to convert documents and photos into PDFand JPEG files. With the Mobile Scanner app, you will be more efficient in work and life!

it.name: Paste – Limitless Clipboard
it.d:
Paste remembers everything you copy — text, links, images, files — on Mac, iPhone, and iPad. So the thing you copied yesterday, last week, or last month is always one shortcut away.

Trusted for 10 years by designers, developers, writers, lawyers, and support teams. Recognized by Apple as an "invaluable utility."

NEVER LOSE A COPY AGAIN
Your clipboard normally holds one item. Paste holds them all.
– Unlimited clipboard history across all your devices
– Clear visual previews — see exactly what you copied, and where it came from
– Rules that automatically skip passwords and other sensitive content

FIND ANYTHING IN SECONDS
– Search everything you've ever copied — even text inside screenshots and photos
– Filter by app, date, device, or content type
– Jump straight from a search result to its place in your history

PASTE AT THE SPEED OF THOUGHT
– Open Paste in any app with a single shortcut
– Paste recent items instantly with ⌘1–9
– Queue items in Paste Stack and paste them in order — perfect for forms and repetitive work
– Paste as plain text whenever you want formatting gone

EVERYWHERE YOU WORK
– iCloud sync keeps Mac, iPhone, and iPad perfectly in step
– Hand off items between devices mid-task
– On iOS: the Paste Keyboard brings your whole history into any app
– Works seamlessly alongside Universal Clipboard

ORGANIZE AND COLLABORATE
– Keep the important stuff on Pinboards — snippets, templates, and assets that never expire
– Share Pinboards with your team, family, or clients
– You decide who can view and who can edit

WORKS WITH YOUR AI TOOLS
– Connect your clipboard history to Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants with built-in MCP support (Mac)
– Polish copied text with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
– Your data lives on your devices and in your private iCloud — never on our servers
– Hide Paste from screen sharing and recordings
– Pause capture any time

Try Paste free for one week. Subscriptions (monthly or annual), a Family plan, and a one-time Lifetime purchase unlock everything on Mac, iPhone, and iPad.

"I don't know how I lived without it" — the thing users tell us most. Copy something. You'll see.

Learn more: pasteapp.io
Say hello: pasteapp.io/contact or @paste_app on X

it.name: Sofa: Downtime Organizer
it.d:
Featured by Apple as “App of the Day”

9to5Mac: “I've found Sofa to be a delight to use.”
MacStories: “My favorite app to manage my media watchlist.”
iMore: “A great way to organize everything from your games to your books.”

————————

Sofa helps you enjoy your downtime by tracking your shows episode by episode, playing your podcasts, planning your trips, and a bunch of other stuff. All in one app.

ORGANIZE WITH LISTS AND GROUPS
Add unlimited lists and groups for categorizing all your stuff: books, games, movies, shows, podcasts, and more.

A HIGHLY FLEXIBLE PROGRESS TRACKING EXPERIENCE
A show you started last month. A book on your nightstand. A game you keep meaning to get back to. Sofa helps you keep track of all of it. Progress rings show up on covers so you can see where you stand at a glance.

A FULL-FEATURED PODCAST PLAYER
Track podcasts and listen to them in the same app. Save a show, queue up episodes, and hit play without switching apps.

A PLANNER FOR TRIPS, TASKS, AND YOUR TV SCHEDULE TOO
The hotel confirmation is in your email. The restaurant list is in Notes. The flight info is in a screenshot somewhere. The Planner puts all of that in one event with day-by-day itineraries, budget scenarios, live weather, and file attachments.

• Tasks with due dates, priorities, and reminders.
• Sticky notes for ideas without a date.
• TV episodes and release dates appear on the timeline automatically.

RIDICULOUSLY POWERFUL LISTS
• Todo Lists or Collection Lists. Hide completed items or keep everything visible.
• Group by genre, author, platform, release year, or custom fields.
• Data Cards show ratings, runtimes, and metadata right on the item.
• Multi-select to move, pin, complete, or remove items in bulk.
• Smart Lists with dozens of filters that auto-populate based on your library.
• Custom fields called Ingredients for your own ratings, tags, and filters.

YOUR DOWNTIME HISTORY
The Logbook catches everything you finish. A Stats dashboard shows activity timelines, genre breakdowns, and year-over-year comparisons.

PLUS WIDGETS, UNIFIED SEARCH, SHORTCUTS ACTIONS, AND MORE
• Widgets with progress rings on your Home and Lock Screen. 
• Unified Search across your library and new content. 
• Dozens of Shortcuts actions.
• A customizable tab bar that lets you hide what you don't use.

————————

ALL THE WONDERFUL THINGS YOU CAN DO WITH SOFA

STANDARD FEATURES (FREE)
• Unlimited Groups & Lists
• Add Basically Anything (movies, TV, books, games, music, podcasts, apps)
• Podcast Player
• Planner (events, tasks, notes, upcoming releases)
• Logbook
• Basic Details (release dates, descriptions, metadata)
• Custom Categories
• iCloud Syncing

SUPER SOFA FEATURES (PAID)
• Progress Tracking (TV episodes, book checkpoints, game progress)
• Event Planning Tools (weather, budgets, attachments)
• Smart Lists (auto-populate based on filters)
• Custom Ingredients (custom ratings, dates, tags)
• Pinned Items & Lists
• List Customization (cover images, large titles, descriptions, layouts)
• Enhanced Podcast Player (chapters, per-show settings)
• Enhanced Details (streaming/music service links)
• Logbook Stats
• Reminders (episodes, events, tasks, notes)
• Sticky Notes
• 100+ Themes & App Icons
• Family Sharing (up to 5 people)

————————

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your App Store account settings after purchase. Cancellation of the current active subscription period is not allowed.

it.name: Widgetsmith
it.d:
Widgetsmith lets you personalize your device like never before with a wide range of highly customizable widgets. It allows you to design your home screen to remind you of the people, places, and words that mean the most to you. 

Widgetsmith showcases your photos, counts down to upcoming events, provides quick access to your favorite music, allows you to check the weather at a glance, and more. You can build widgets with Actions to launch apps, run Shortcuts, send a text, and more, from your home screen or Control Center.

Widgetsmith includes a library of iPhone wallpapers and a tool to theme your widgets to perfectly complement these wallpapers or any of your own.

Each widget can be adjusted precisely to fit your desired appearance and function, using various colors, fonts, borders, and themes. With Widgetsmith, you can create your perfect home screen aesthetic and easily change it over time. 

WIDGETS:
You can create almost anything with Widgetsmith, using the wide range of widget types offered in the app! Here are some favorites:

Photos: Highlight your favorite images across your home screens with a range of filters and borders
Photo Galleries: View photos in an album or customized collection
Customizable Date & Time Clocks
Activity Tracking & Step Counting
Countdown Timers
Solar & Lunar Trackers
Weather Conditions & Forecasts
Time Zone Tracker

Widgetsmith lets you customize not only your home screen but also your lock screen! You can view inspirational song lyrics, a photo of a loved one, weather information, and more without unlocking your device.

WALLPAPERS:

Widgetsmith includes a collection of phone wallpapers from various artists. These can be downloaded directly from the app and used to create custom widget themes to quickly and easily theme your entire home screen in a pleasing color palette. 

FLEXIBILITY:
If you want different widgets at different times of day, Widgetsmith has you covered! For example, a widget could show the weather in the morning, your calendar during your work day, and then switch to your Activity ring progress as you wrap up your day. This lets you take full advantage of each slot on your home screen.

IN-APP TOOLS:
Wisgetsmith is also home to a wide range of valuable tools, including:

A weather app with air quality, pollen, and tide information
A full-featured time zone converter
Charts to review activity and workout data

NOTES:
Widgetsmith is designed to optionally integrate with Apple Health to display your steps and activity. Permission for Widgetsmith to access this data is controlled through the Apple Health app.
Widgetsmith can also integrate with your photos, Apple Music library, calendars, reminders, and more. Access to this information is handled using the standard iOS/iPadOS/watchOS privacy prompts, which are shown only in Widgetsmith.
Widgetsmith includes an optional premium subscription. This is offered on a monthly or annual basis. If you choose to purchase a subscription, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings in the App Store.
Access to tide and weather data is only available to Widgetsmith Premium subscribers.

it.name: Dropshare - File Sharing Tool
it.d:
Dropshare makes it easy to upload and share files from your iPhone or iPad using storage you already trust.

Upload files, photos, videos, and more, then instantly get a download link you can share anywhere. Whether you want to use your own server, S3-compatible storage, or popular cloud services, Dropshare gives you a faster and more flexible file sharing workflow on iOS.

Why Dropshare:
• Share files quickly via download URL
• Upload from Photos, Files, or the Share Extension
• Upload one file, multiple files, or ZIP archives
• Sync upload history across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
• Use custom domains and supported URL shorteners
• Create custom download pages matching your personal or professional identity
• Supports Shortcuts for faster automation

Supported storage providers include cloud, file, image, and protocol-based services such as:

Cloud Storage:
• Amazon S3
• S3 API-compatible services (including OpenStack Swift, DreamObjects, and more)
• Backblaze B2
• Rackspace Cloud Files
• Filebase
• Scaleway Object Storage
• Linode Object Storage
• Microsoft Azure Blob Storage
• IDrive e2
• MinIO
• Alibaba Object Storage
• Bunny Storage
• Contabo Object Storage
• DigitalOcean Spaces
• Google Cloud Storage
• Hetzner Object Storage
• MEGA Object Storage

File Storage:
• Google Drive
• Box
• Dropbox
• OneDrive
• pCloud
• Nextcloud
• Horizon
• Zoho WorkDrive
• Koofr
• kDrive
• Fastmail Files

Image Storage:
• Flickr
• ImgBB
• Imgur
• vgy.me
• Lensdump

Protocol Services:
• SCP over SSH
• FTP / FTPS
• SFTP
• WebDAV

Dropshare also supports URL shorteners including Rebrandly, Bitly, short.io, and more. dsh.re is the built-in shortener and also supports custom domains.

Technical notes:
• SCP, FTP / FTPS, SFTP, and WebDAV require a working server account. Password or SSH key authentication may be required.
• S3 API-compatible services such as OpenStack Swift and DreamObjects are supported. See the User Guide for setup details.
• Google Drive, Box, Dropbox, OneDrive, pCloud, Nextcloud, Koofr, Horizon, Fastmail Files, and kDrive require an account with the respective provider.
• Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Rackspace Cloud Files, Scaleway Object Storage, Linode Object Storage, Microsoft Azure Blob Storage, Alibaba Object Storage, Bunny Storage, Contabo Object Storage, DigitalOcean Spaces, Google Cloud Storage, Hetzner Object Storage, MEGA Object Storage, and MinIO may require a paid plan depending on the provider.

End User License Agreement:

it.name: Duet Display
it.d:
#1 best-selling iPad app in US, Japan, UK, Germany, and 17 other countries!

Duet turns your iPad or iPhone into the most advanced extra display for your Mac & PC. Developed by a team of ex-Apple engineers, Duet offers unparalleled performance and display quality - all with zero lag.

— DO MORE —
Be twice as productive by multitasking with two screens. And for those that travel, have a portable way to stay productive. 

— INCREDIBLY SIMPLE —
To get started, plug your iPad into your desktop using your charging cable. The free Duet desktop app will automatically detect your device, and transform it into a high performance touchscreen display.

There’s no need to worry about unreliable Wi-Fi, laggy performance, pixelated screens or managing network passwords. 

— TOUCHSCREEN —
Interact with Mac & PC like never before, with touch & gestures, including two-finger scrolling, pan and zoom.

And with our latest release, you can even add a touch bar to any iPad with any Mac.

— PERFECT FOR APPLE PENCIL —
With Duet Pro, you can turn your iPad and Apple Pencil into a professional graphics tablet. We’ve re-engineered our rendering algorithms for ultra-responsive drawing, optimized specifically for designers, illustrators and artists.

Duet Pro also unlocks pressure & tilt sensitivity, hover, palm rejection, and more to seamlessly draw in the most powerful programs for professionals. Get precise control in Photoshop, Corel Painter, Lightroom, ToonBoom, Illustrator, Manga Studio and more. 

— PRESS —
TechCrunch - "Feels Like Magic"
TIME - "Getting Work Done Faster and More Efficiently"
The Guardian - "Lag-free"
Forbes - "The simple thing to note is this...Duet Display works."
The Verge - "Glorious Fluidity"
Lifehacker - "It's fast, easy to use, and works great"
Business Insider - "Zero lag and true retina resolution”
Wall Street Journal - “It’s as easy as just plugging it in"

— REVIEWS —

~CEO of T-Mobile, John Legere

“Very smooth and responsive indeed, plus you could use the touch screen to “click” on screen interfaces!”
~Photographer, Lok Cheung

~Former Chief Evangelist of Apple, Guy Kawasaki

~Comedian and Youtube, Phillip DeFranco

All PCs with Windows 7 and later

Meet Tiimo: Your AI planning partner that simplifies executive function, focus and productivity.

Whether you are building routines, navigating time agnosia, or just trying to make it through a busy week, Tiimo helps reduce mental load and makes it easier to follow through. Planning becomes something that supports you, not something that drains you.
Join 1+ million users who trust Tiimo as their neurodivergent-friendly planner.

KEY FEATURES

AI Co-Planner: A personal planning assistant that supports you in creating, prioritizing and planning tasks that works for you, so you can focus on what matters.
Visual Schedule Planner: Color-coded daily overview with easy drag-and-drop tasks.
To-Do List: Brain dump your tasks, prioritize them in a click with the AI priority grouping.
Focus Timer: A calming countdown to guide your time, and stay on track.
Sync with Apple Calendar and Reminders: Keep all your schedules and plans in one place.
Widgets: Your key tasks and timers always in view on your home or lock screen.
Share up to 5 profiles with family

SUPPORTING TOOLS

Community Hub: Tips from neurodivergent teens and adults

“Tiimo I love you- you’ve pretty much changed my life!! I didn’t think I could be organized. But this week, I completed 94 tasks. This app def deserves the five stars!"

Co-designed with ADHD/Autism experts

it.name: NotePlan - To-Do List & Notes
it.d:
Having trouble planning your day, managing your to-do list, and organizing your notes? Always jumping between apps and losing track of what to do and where you put things?

Say hello to NotePlan!

NotePlan lets you manage everything in one place: your tasks, notes, and calendar.
Perfect for project managers, designers, researchers, writers, students, or anyone who wants to be organized and efficient.

QUICKLY PLAN YOUR DAY WITH MARKDOWN
• Plan your day by seeing your calendar, notes, and tasks in a single view
• Create tasks and notes quickly with Markdown
• Add #tags to organize tasks and notes
• Use @mentions to find people
• Reschedule to-do items easily
• Create flexible recurring tasks
• Work faster with autocomplete

BUILD YOUR NETWORK OF NOTES
• Create your own network of notes
• Organize any way you want to: from simple folders over P.A.R.A. to a Zettelkasten system
• Bi-directional notes: link your calendar and your notes in any direction, automatically
• Cross-reference and link notes easily

STAY ON TOP OF THINGS WITH REVIEW
• Search all tasks and notes, instantly
• See all open tasks with the click of a button
• Get a list of overdue to-do items
• See upcoming tasks at a glance
• Create custom filters with your own queries using status, #tags, @mentions, or even text

SEAMLESS INTEGRATION WITH YOUR CALENDAR
• Create events and reminders right in NotePlan
• Support for iCloud, Google, and Exchange calendars
• Time-block tasks on your calendar simply by typing

AVAILABLE ON MAC, IPHONE & IPAD
• Sync everything between your Apple devices
• Use any sync method you like: CloudKit or iCloud Drive
• A single subscription for all your devices

OPEN, PRIVATE & FAST
• All your notes are stored in plaintext so you're never locked in
• Your information is private and cannot be accessed
• Enjoy lightning speed thanks to local files and native apps

ANY THEME YOU WANT
• Choose from a variety of built-in themes
• Work with light or dark versions
• Create your own custom theme

SHORTCUTS FOR MAXIMUM SPEED
• Extended Markdown syntax support with customization options
• Move around without ever leaving the keyboard
• Find everything with the Global Command Bar

NotePlan is developed independently and prioritizes user features and requests. We have long-term roadmaps and listen to customers to improve the apps.

- - - - -

Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings.

it.name: MapleRead CX
it.d:
MapleRead is dedicated to enable unique audio-visual reading experience for everyone.

------------
Our MapleRead app family has 3 members, namely SE, CE and CX.
- SE is our flagship product with all features.
- CE is SE without PDF reader and built-in Library Server.
- CX is CE with some limitation. Free to try.
- No recurring subscription fees. No ads. Just buy it once. Gratuity optional.
- Moreover, SE and CE can be run side-by-side via split-view multitasking.
- Recommend SE for use on multiple devices with easy and fast book sharing via Library Server.
- Recommend the SE-CE bundle for the best value.
------------

MapleRead includes a superb audio-visual EPUB e-book reader.
- It lets you easily modify publisher's original book style to better suit your aesthetic taste.
- It lets you instantly generate pseudo audiobooks with a choice of narrator voices over 40 languages.
- It enables immersion reading so that you may read and listen to the same book in sync.
- Background listening works well too. Compatible with Lock Screen Music Player and CarPlay.

MapleRead UI is friendly to users of all ages.
- Books can be read in regular and large print.
- A choice of UI text sizes makes reading in non-book views much more comfortable.

MapleRead is a great learning tool.
- It lets you look up words, translate sentences, search text, highlight text and write notes.
- It helps you collect vocabulary and organize notes with various priorities.
- It provides hooks to user-defined dictionaries, translators, and other tools.
- Immersion reading improves your comprehension, especially of foreign-language books.

MapleRead is an effective and fast library management tool.
- It is designed for you, a book lover, who may own a huge and/or growing book collection.
- It lets you keep all your books in one place and well-organized automatically.
- It lets you display your books elegantly in style.
- It lets you easily repair individual book metadata.
- If supports multiple book sets and multiple tags.
- It offers multiple ways to import and export books, and works well with Calibre.

MapleRead offers unprecedented user-defined customization options.
- They include unlimited user-defined fonts, book themes, cover images and library scenes.
- Each book theme includes various types of user-defined highlight colors.
- Each book can have its own theme, and each EPUB book can have its own style.

[For more technical details, screenshots, FAQ and reviews, please visit our website.]

it.name: Across: Calendar, Your Way
it.d:
Across is a calendar you can start using right away, then customize as much as you like. With a wide range of views and deep customization, it becomes more your own every day.

Across doesn't lock you in. Your events stay safely in Apple and Google, while Across helps you view and manage them the way you want. Our goal is simple: not to keep you locked in, but to be the calendar you'll want to keep using.

Across works seamlessly with Apple Calendar, Reminders, and Google Calendar, and stays in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. No ads. Any data we collect is never linked to your identity.

What Across offers:
* 12+ calendar views
* Monthly view with up to two lines per event and adjustable spacing
* Weekly and multi-day views with continuous day-by-day scrolling
* Deep customization of tabs, views, fonts, colors, and themes
* Routine and recurring event management
* Event templates, natural language event creation, and more
* Anniversary and D-day countdowns
* Widgets that show your upcoming events at a glance
* Events and tasks managed in one place

For those who love to plan, a precise planning tool. For those who don't, a simple way to stay on top of your days.

it.name: Noteful: Notes & PDF Markup
it.d:
Noteful is your one-stop note-taking app to experience the new paperless revolution on iPad. 

Perfect for annotating documents, taking class notes or even building your personal knowledge system. It is time to put aside the paper clutter, as Noteful is a versatile tool that helps you to accelerate your learning and knowledge work.

Take Beautiful Handwritten Notes
• Natural, fluid and precise handwriting experience
• Precise handwriting on iPad with Apple Pencil native support
• Custom-built ink engine InfiniteStroke that captures and converts your strokes into high-resolution vector ink
• 3 brushes available: ballpoint pen, fountain pen and highlighter
• Switch between pen sizes and colours
• Recognise geometrical shapes

Markup, Highlight, Annotate 
• Import PDFs, MS Office documents to a notebook
• Add images, shapes and typed text to notes
• Use multiple paper templates in a single notebook
• Export and share handwritten annotations as PDF
• Use Quick Create to create a new notebook for quick sketching

Powerful Tagging
• Organise quickly by tagging with #tag or even #nested/tag anywhere in notebooks
• More flexible than folders; Notes can be organised by subjects, by topics or by priorities
• Browse notebooks or pages by tags
• Rename, delete or re-assign tags to easily re-organise your library

Layers in Notebook
• Add annotation on separate layers without changing original content*
• Hide or show layers independently
• Rearrange layers
• Make it possible to composite complex layout*

All Your Notes, All the Time
• Sync to all your iPhone and iPad devices*
• Take textbooks, slides, handwritten notes and PDF documents with you wherever you go
• Notebooks synced with iCloud are encrypted via account-based keys

Powerful Editing
• Erase strokes with eraser
• Double tap on Apple Pencil to switch to eraser tool
• Move and resize annotations with lasso tool
• Unlimited undo, redo
• Support Split View for multitasking

Audio Record Notes
• Record audio while you take notes
• Audio playback position synced with the notes

Modern App Design
• A minimalist UI that maximizes content space
• Streamlined design that requires fewer taps for common functions
