it.name: Adobe Scan: PDF & Doc Scanner
it.d:
Major update: The new Digitize tool lets you scan handwritten notes and whiteboards into editable, searchable documents that look digitally created. Currently available in beta.

Adobe Scan is free to download and turns your mobile device into a powerful PDF and document scanner that helps you create, save, and organize your paper documents as digital files.

6 WAYS TO USE ADOBE SCAN
1) Save time with a fast document scanner: Use High-speed scan to bulk scan documents and turn stacks into PDFs in seconds.

2) Clean up scans with Magic eraser: Auto-detect and remove thumbs, shadows, stains and creases so your document scans look clear and professional.

3) Make a PDF with your phone: Convert paper documents or printed images into PDFs or JPEGs with the mobile PDF and photo scanner.

4) Use the Extract pages tool to choose the pages you need from any multi-page scan and save them as a new PDF.

5) Turn images to text: Use the image-to-text feature to make words in your scans searchable and editable with OCR.

6) Scan anything: Receipts, IDs, notes, recipes, photos, business cards, whiteboards – scan documents into PDF or JPEG files you can work with on your phone, tablet, or computer.

CAPTURE WITH PRECISION
• The Straighten tool fixes pages that come out curved or tilted while you scan, even if all four corners aren’t visible in the scan.
• Advanced scanning technology detects borders, sharpens content, and makes your scans editable and searchable.

ENHANCE YOUR SCANS
• Edit in text lets you scan words, and handwritten text, to make it editable.
• The Modify tool helps you crop, rotate, resize, and adjust colors in your scans.
• Reorder pages and preview before saving.
• Adjust the brightness and contrast of your scans in just a few taps.

ORGANIZE YOUR DOCUMENTS
• Scan paperwork and create custom folders for work documents, personal files, school forms, or ID scans.
• Contact details are pulled straight from business cards so you can save them to your phone contacts in seconds.
• Scans are automatically saved to Adobe Document Cloud for instant access and sharing.
• Set a password to keep that important scan secure while you send it.

SMART LIBRARY
• This powerful doc scanner finds documents and receipts in your photo library and turns them into PDFs.
• Touch up scans or photos directly from your camera roll.

REUSE & SHARE
• Open PDFs directly in Adobe Scan, without leaving the app. Then use tools like Modify, Edit, and Share.
• Make high-quality PDFs that unlock text from images – from scanned contracts to study notes – so you can copy, edit, and reuse.
• Export your scans to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint for new formats, then share.

DO MORE WITH ACROBAT READER
• Open your PDF scan in Acrobat Reader to comment, highlight, fill forms, and sign documents.
• Access and share securely across Scan, Reader, and Acrobat on web and mobile.

IN-APP PURCHASE
• Subscribe for even more scanning power. Subscriptions work across Scan and Reader mobile apps and Acrobat on the web.
• Combine scans into one file so you can take multiple scans and consolidate into one document.
• Increase OCR capacity from 5 to 100 pages so that you can find text in multiple images.

Download this free mobile scanner to convert important photos and documents into PDF and JPEG files to help you stay organized. Adobe Scan is the PDF converter trusted by millions worldwide.

desc:

it.name: Things 3 for iPad
it.d:
Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.

Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today.

“Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.”
—Wirecutter, The New York Times


KEY FEATURES

• Your To-Dos
Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps.

• Your Projects
Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule.

• Your Areas
Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion.

• Your Plan
Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :)


MORE THINGS TO LOVE

As you dive deeper, you’ll find Things packed with helpful features. Here are just a few:

• Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you.
• Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set.
• This Evening — a special place for your evening plans.
• Calendar integration — see your events and to-dos together.
• Tags — categorize your to-dos and quickly filter lists.
• Quick Find — instantly locate to-dos, headings, or tags.
• Type Travel — jump from list to list with your keyboard; just start typing!
• Magic Plus — drag the + button to insert to-dos anywhere in a list.
• Share extension — create to-dos with content from other apps.
• Widgets — see lists on your home/lock screens.
• Mail to Things — forward an email to Things; now it’s a to-do.
• Markdown — structure & style your notes.
• And much more!


MADE FOR IPAD

Things is tailored to the iPad, with excellent pro features as well. Chief among them is the outstanding support for your keyboard & trackpad. You can edit your to-dos without touching the screen, utilize plenty of shortcuts, and navigate your lists at blistering speed—just start typing!

“Things has the best implementation of external keyboard support I’ve ever seen in an iPad app.”
—Federico Viticci, MacStories

You can also enjoy a beautiful dark mode at sunset, connect your calendars, open multiple windows, add a variety of widgets, scribble with Apple Pencil, create to-dos via Siri, import from Reminders—Things can do it all! There’s even Shortcuts integration if you want to automate your workflows.


AWARD-WINNING DESIGN

Made in Stuttgart, with two Apple Design Awards to its name, Things is a fine example of German engineering: designed not only to look fantastic, but to be perfectly functional as well. Every detail is thoughtfully considered, then polished to perfection.

“It’s like the unicorn of productivity tools: deep enough for serious work, surprisingly easy to use, and gorgeous enough to enjoy staring at.”
—Apple


GET THINGS TODAY

Whatever it is you want to accomplish in life, Things can help you get there. Install the app today and see what you can do!

• Things is also available for Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro (sold separately).
• Sync is provided for free via our Things Cloud service.
• A free trial is available for Mac: www.things.app

If you have any questions, please get in touch. We provide professional support and will be glad to help you!

it.name: UTM Virtual Machines
it.d:
UTM lets you run Windows® 11, Ubuntu®, or macOS(*) fully virtualized with maximum performance. Run Windows® 7, Windows® XP, and other older operating system emulated with decent performance.

UTM uses the popular QEMU system emulator securely in a sandboxed environment to protect your data from viruses and malware in the emulated operating system.

Designed for macOS using the latest and greatest Apple technologies, UTM is built from the ground up with the Mac in mind.

Features:

 • Run ARM64 operating systems such as Windows® for ARM and Ubuntu® ARM on your Apple Silicon Mac fully virtualized at near native speeds
 • Run Intel/AMD operating system such as Windows® 7, Windows® XP, Ubuntu® Linux, and more (emulated with limited performance on Apple Silicon Macs, fully virtualized on Intel Macs)
 • Run macOS 12 or higher in a virtualized environment(*)
 • Run Intel applications on Linux with Rosetta(**)
 • Over 30 processors can be emulated by the QEMU backend including i386, x64, ARM32, ARM64, MIPS, PPC, and RISC-V for developers and enthusiasts
 • Supports macOS Sandbox to protect your data from any viruses or malware infecting the emulated operating system (such as Windows®)
 • GUI display mode, terminal console mode, and headless mode (with support for multiple displays)
 • Attach USB devices to your virtual machine
 • Experimental: GPU accelerated OpenGL on Linux VMs
 • Bridged and shared networking support
 • Run and store VMs from external drives
 • Don't know how to use QEMU? Confused at all the options QEMU provides? UTM provides an easy to understand UI for creating and configuring VMs that does not require knowledge of QEMU command line arguments

Current Limitations:

We are working hard to provide new features. Below are some things currently missing from UTM. We hope to support at least some of these features in the future.

 • No direct mounting of external disks and drives, only mounting disk images is supported
 • No drag & drop of files and data, only copy paste of text and sharing of a single directory is supported with tools installed
 • No GPU acceleration for Windows® and only experimental OpenGL acceleration for Linux (most Windows® games will NOT run)
 • macOS virtualization only runs on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 12 and up. macOS 12 does not support USB sharing, copy/paste, or dynamic resolution.

(*) macOS virtualization is only supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 12 and up.
(**) Linux with Rosetta is only supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 and up.

it.name: Awesome Habits: Habit Tracker
it.d:
Don't set goals, build habits.

Do you remember the last time you set out to achieve something? Perhaps you started strong, full of determination, but over time, your motivation waned. Here’s our tip – instead of setting unmanageable goals, start building and improving your regular habits and daily routines. Small and easy changes will compound into remarkable results. With our app, you will get better every day and achieve the kind of success that lasts.

Build good habits, break bad ones.
Want to live healthier, feel better, or be more productive? Possibilities are unlimited. Get inspiration from pre-defined templates, discover habit ideas with on-device Apple Intelligence, or create your own custom habit.

Achieve your daily, weekly, and monthly goals.
Using a simple overview, you can easily manage all your goals and see your achievements. Have you overachieved your goal? You can track that too.

Track your progress and streaks.
Browse history, check out your stats and see how you've improved over time.
Didn't have time to track a previous day? No problem, you can easily update any record in the past.

Features:
- Build good habits, break bad ones
- Daily, weekly, and monthly goals
- Get habit ideas with private, on-device Apple Intelligence (where available)
- Track even overachieved goals
- Track time-based goals with timers
- Powerful statistics with heatmaps
- Habit lists
- Habit notes
- 2,500+ icons and emojis, with support for Genmoji and custom stickers
- Dark Mode and appearance customization
- Health app integration
- Reminders, alarms, app badge, and Health app notifications
- Interactive widgets for Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy mode
- Interactive Dynamic Island & Live Activities
- Control Center widgets
- Apple Watch complications and the Smart Stack widget
- Export to a CSV file
- Siri Shortcuts
- iCloud backup & sync
- Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch

Terms of Use: https://www.awesome-habits.com/terms-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://www.awesome-habits.com/privacy-policy

it.name: Productive - Habit Tracker
it.d:
Meet Productive - the app that helps you build positive life-changing habits. With Productive, you can set personal goals, track your progress, and focus on what makes you healthier, happier and more productive!

FEATURES

HABIT MANAGEMENT
Create, complete, stop, or pause habits whenever it is convenient for you. Add notes to your habits to highlight the main points during the day.

PROGRAMS
Сhoose your goal, receive daily habit tips, reflection check-ins, and motivation prompts to get the boost you need.

CHALLENGES
Improve your daily routine by completing guided tasks and competing with other users from all over the world.

ARTICLES
Grow awareness of your own productivity and motivation with personalized expert insights.

CUSTOMIZATION
Customize the app the way you want! You can name your habit, choose a unique icon, and even pick its color.

STATISTICS
Track your habits and analyze progress by building motivating chains of completed habits and perfect days. The longer your chain of completed habits, the more likely you will keep the streak going.

NOTIFICATIONS
Set up smart reminders, and personalize the app to get notifications of what's scheduled for each part of the day.

ADHD ASSISTANCE
Manage distractions and deal with ADHD by concentrating on a focused daily routine.

PREMIUM FEATURES
- Unlimited number of habits
- Endless motivation with various challenges
- Full-text articles to draw inspiration 
- Improved reminders for individual habits
- Location-based reminders
- Motivating stats for each habit
- Habit trends with week-by-week data

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose. 
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.

If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please do not hesitate to contact us at productive@bendingspoons.com

it.name: Scan Hero: PDF Scanner
it.d:
Looking for a mobile assistant? Try the Scan Hero app to corral your paperwork and scan documents on the go! 
Scan Hero helps you run your business in the ever-changing digital world. Scan documents to PDF, then sign, edit, and share them – no heavy equipment needed! Manage paperwork hassle-free from anywhere – the office, remotely, or from home. Stay one step ahead when it comes to document management.

Loved by more than 29 million users.


SCAN DOCUMENTS
- Scan any document automatically or manually and save it as a PDF file or image.
- Try various Camera Modes to scan specific types of documents.
- Adjust the quality and file size of your scans: choose low, medium, or high quality.
- Import documents right from Photos for further editing and sharing.

TRY CAMERA MODES
- Single Mode captures a single page.
- Multi Mode scans two pages at once.
- Passport & ID Card Modes digitize your ID-documents. 
- Book Mode scans a two-page spread of a book.
- QR Mode reads QR codes with your device’s Camera.

MAKE EDITS
- Re-crop scans, change page perspective and borders, apply filters, adjust contrast, and correct or change the orientation.
- Organize and reorder pages in multipage documents.  

MANAGE SCANS
- Print scanned documents and clipboard text wirelessly.
- Share scans separately or send a number of files in one PDF file via Mail or iMessage.
- Save all your scans to Photos or iCloud and synchronize them between all of your iOS devices. 
- Protect your files with Face ID or passcode.

LEVEL UP WITH PREMIUM FEATURES
- Recognize and extract text from your scans with OCR (Optical Character Recognition) technology. 
Available for texts in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Turkish, Russian, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Swedish, Polish, Norwegian, Japanese, and Portuguese.
- Fine-tune scans by selecting HD quality while scanning.
- Sign scans right on the screen of your device. Create and save one or more signatures, and add them to scans whenever you need.
- Highlight the key points of your scans.
- Secure private information in scanned documents using the Hide tool.
- Scan and share without limits.

*For advanced editing and file management, you can also try our PDF Hero app!

it.name: Flow: Focus & Pomodoro Timer
it.d:
Join hundreds of thousands of happy users who enjoy this simple way to stay focused and productive. Use Flow to get things done.

Flow is a tiny but mighty app that helps you work on a task, study for school or simply stay focused without being distracted for a certain amount of time. Flow divides your workflow into sections with defined breaks, making it easy to stay focused. This method has been scientifically proven to be an effective way to increase your concentration and motivation while reducing your stress levels. The use of a Pomodoro timer can be a huge boost to your productivity.

Use Flow to ...
... concentrate
... work on a task
... study for school
... code all night
... work from home

Benefits of this technique
• Improved focus and motivation
• Increased productivity
• Less stress and better health
• Better management of interruptions

Features
• Pomodoro timer with work intervals and breaks
• Statistics to keep track of your completed sessions
• Notifications to remind you of short breaks
• App and web blocking to combat distractions
• Commitment mode for self-control
• Inspirational quotes for motivation
• Metronome for deep focus
• Multiple duration options
• Custom session title
• Apple Calendar sync
• Apple Health sync
• iCloud sync of stats
• Home & Lock Screen Widgets
• Support for Live Activities & Dynamic Island


YOU MATTER TO US

We want to make Flow even better! Please give us your honest feedback in order to help us fix bugs and improve the app. We will regularly update Flow based on your feedback. Thank you!


ABOUT US

Yugen is a small independent developer studio based in Frankfurt, Germany. Our team is devoted to making great apps that we want to use ourselves. We strive to create products that help people in their everyday life with intuitive user experiences and minimalistic design.


QUESTIONS?

If you have any questions or problems, feel free to email us. We provide awesome support and love to help!

www.flow.app
support@flow.app
Twitter: flow__app
Facebook: flowapp.info
Instagram: flowapp.info

it.name: BeFreed: Get Smarter Daily!
it.d:
Tell BeFreed what you want to grow into — more charismatic, a sharper leader, a better partner, calmer under pressure. BeFreed builds you a personalized audio learning plan from bestselling books, research papers, interviews, and expert talks, then adapts it as you go. The goal isn't hours listened. It's who you actually become.

Join 500,000+ learners worldwide. #1 Personalized Learning App 2026.

WHAT MAKES BEFREED DIFFERENT
* A personal trainer for the skill you want to master: Charisma, communication, leadership, relationships, confidence — whatever you want to get better at, BeFreed builds your plan around it. Add your own sources if you have them, or let BeFreed pull from the best ones for you.
* A learning plan that's truly yours: A quick assessment dials in where you actually are, what's getting in your way, and what you need next. BeFreed turns that into a sequenced path drawing from books, research, interviews, and expert talks. A real curriculum that goes somewhere. As you progress, the plan keeps adapting to who you're becoming.
* Audio lessons in your voice, length, and style: Pick 5, 15, or 25 minutes. Choose how it sounds — TL;DR, Story Mode, Explain Like I'm 5, Deep Dive, Debate, Gossip Girl, or Over Coffee. 10+ natural voices. Available in 10+ languages. Some options require a subscription or in-app purchase.
* Practice with live feedback: The point of learning is doing. Rehearse the conversations that actually matter — giving tough feedback, asking for a raise, setting a boundary — out loud, with real-time coaching. Insight turns into behavior.
* Notes that remember what matters: Your highlights and key takeaways, organized into a personal library that grows with you — so the lessons that hit stay with you, instead of fading by next week.
* Real-world growth, not vanity metrics: BeFreed tracks how you're actually changing across the things you care about — social skills, relationships, psychology, mental wellness, career — and reshapes your plan as you level up. 10 minutes a day, real progress you can feel.

WHY LEARNERS CHOOSE BEFREED
* Built for real-world growth — every lesson, prompt, and practice session is designed to change how you show up, not just what you know
* A plan that's actually yours — it starts from your goal and situation, and keeps adapting as you grow
* Beyond book summaries — learn from books, research papers, interviews, and expert talks
* Your format, your way — choose voice, length, and style. Fits your life — 5 minutes on your commute or 25 for a deep dive.
* Knowledge you can trust — fact-checked, source-cited, no fluff
* Replace doomscrolling — bite-sized learning that compounds into something real

Topics: productivity, leadership, emotional intelligence, communication, charisma, investing, psychology, relationships, self-confidence, mindfulness, and more.

Be curious. Be consistent. BeFreed.

—

it.name: iA Writer
it.d:
“Leaving life’s mess for an ideal realm of words.” —The New Yorker

“My favorite iOS app for writing in Markdown, without question, is iA Writer. iA Writer is just beautiful. To me, it’s the gold standard for Markdown syntax styling... an elegant champagne flute. That’s iA Writer for me.” —John Gruber

“iA Writer creates a clean, simple and distraction-free writing environment for when you really need to focus on your words.” —The New York Times

“iA Writer is an example of how powerful simplicity and accessibility can be.” —The Guardian

“iA Writer is all about textual production—writing this phrase, this sentence, this word at this moment.” —WIRED

4 x Best of App Store Winner

# The Simple Writing App
iA Writer removes distractions. Giving you a calm, focused, writing space, so you can express yourself clearly.

# Focus
Focus Mode dims everything but the current sentence or paragraph, helping you stay in the flow.

# Start
Don’t worry about the format. First, write in plain text. Then preview in HTML. 

# Organize
Search, sort, and quickly swap between documents from different clouds.

# Customize
When you tap and hold a key in the command keyboard, you’re given the chance to choose your own layout. Rearrange your keys, or pick new ones from the extensive list.

# Search
You can open documents and launch frequent actions in no time with the new Quick Search. It lives in the keyboard so it’s always close at hand.

# Work
iA Writer includes an inverted light-on-dark-mode, perfect for working day and night.

# Clean
Spot superfluous adjectives, weak verbs, repetitive nouns, false conjunctions and clean your text of the usual rumble. 

# Shape
Customize your templates and export to WordPress or Medium, HTML, Microsoft Word (.docx), or PDF. 

# 100% Text
Embed links, pictures, tables and text files in plain text and see them in preview.

# Get in Touch
- Visit ia.net/writer for more information
- Visit ia.net/writer/support for support and feedback

The daily planner built for how your brain actually works. Map your tasks and calendar onto a visual timeline, block your time with intention, and finally build a routine that sticks — whether you have ADHD or just a lot on your plate.

WHY STRUCTURED WORKS

Most planners give you a blank page. Structured gives you a timeline. You see your whole day laid out, with every task, event, and routine in order. It's time blocking made simple.

Built for ADHD minds, busy professionals, and students who need more than a to-do list.

FREE FEATURES

- Visual day planner with an intuitive drag-and-drop timeline
- Inbox to capture ideas fast and sort them later

- Connect your calendars and Reminders for a complete daily schedule organizer
- Build recurring tasks and routines
- AI-powered day planning: draft your schedule in seconds
- Replan: automatically reschedules missed or forgotten tasks
- Custom notifications to match your workflow

PERFECT FOR

- ADHD-friendly daily planning that actually sticks
- Time blocking your work and study sessions
- Morning routine and evening routine planning
- Students managing class timetables and study tasks
- Anyone who wants a simple to-do list app with a timeline view
- Habit tracking alongside your daily task planner

YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY

Structured isn't just a task manager or a habit tracker. It's the daily planner that puts everything in one place — so you can plan your day, build better habits, and get things done without the overwhelm.

Structured Pro is available monthly, annually, or as a lifetime purchase.

it.d:
The official AutoCAD app. View & edit CAD drawings anytime, anywhere!


Essential drafting and design capabilities for your everyday needs: Autodesk® AutoCAD® Web on mobile is a trusted solution that gives you access to the core AutoCAD commands that you need for light editing and generating fundamental designs, all at an attractive price.

AutoCAD Web subscription plans are available in the following options:
•	Monthly for $9.99
•	Yearly for $99.99 
•	Included free with AutoCAD and AutoCAD LT subscriptions


Use familiar AutoCAD drafting tools on your mobile device in a simplified interface, allowing you to access, create, and update DWG™ files anytime, anywhere.

30 day trial: Enjoy a fully functional free trial of AutoCAD Web for 30 days. After the trial is completed, you can access limited read-only functionality without a paid subscription.

Current AutoCAD or AutoCAD LT desktop subscribers: Sign in with your Autodesk account to access AutoCAD Web on mobile.

Key Benefits:
•	Work offline on your projects without an Internet connection and sync later
•	Safeguard drawings in your Autodesk account or with your own external accounts
•	Collaborate in real time with team members and reduce mistakes
•	Replace blueprints at job sites with drawings on mobile
•	Simplify workflows by opening DWG files directly from Autodesk Drive, Autodesk Docs, Microsoft OneDrive, Box, Dropbox, or Google Drive.

Features:
•	2D file viewing 
•	Create, edit, and share 2D drawings 
•	Work offline and sync your changes once back online
•	Insert blocks from your DWG drawing 
•	Manage layers and layer visibility 
•	Drafting and geometry editing tools 
•	Annotation and markup tools 
•	Measure distance, angle, area, and radius 
•	View and edit DWG files from your internal storage, email, or from the cloud
•	View coordinates and properties


All new users have access to a free trial of AutoCAD Web for 30 days.

Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your Apple ID. 

Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless cancelled at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel a subscription during the active period. Manage your subscriptions in Account Settings after purchase.

*Free products and services are subject to the Autodesk Terms of Use at https://www.autodesk.com/company/terms-of-use/en/general-terms 

Learn more:
Autodesk Website: https://www.autodesk.com/products/autocad-web
Term of Use: https://www.autodesk.com/company/legal-notices-trademarks/terms-of-service-autodesk360-web-services/autodesk-autocad-mobile-terms-of-service

AutoCAD Service is not provided to children under the age of 14, and users under 14 cannot use this Service.

it.name: Bear Markdown Notes & Journal
it.d:
Bear is a beautiful, powerfully simple Markdown app to capture, write, and organize your life.
​
Take notes, plan your day, journal thoughts, organize tables, create lists and tasks, sketch ideas, link notes together, write a book, and much more. Bear is used by writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students, parents.. you get the picture. Getting started couldn’t be faster—no signup and no account. Just open a note and write naturally.
​
"My journaling app of choice is Bear" - Kit Eaton, New York Times
​
* 2017 Apple Design Award 
* 2016 App Store App of the Year
* Editors' choice for 7 consecutive years
* Most of our parents love it
​
## BEAUTIFUL. SIMPLE. POWERFUL. PRIVATE

- Tools stay out of your way so you can just write
- Sketch ideas on iPad with an extendable canvas and Apple Pencil (and other styli)
- Clip web pages and other content with Bear’s app extension
- The redesigned Info Panel now with Table of Contents and Backlinks
- Use Apple Watch to dictate and append to recent notes
- Support for all the scripts including RTL languages like Arabic, Hebrew, and Persian
- Easily create notes with Siri and Shortcuts
- Your notes, not ours - Bear is private at its core: We cannot see your notes, tags, or anything else
​
## FLEXIBLE MARKDOWN
​
- Work in plain text - easy to move between apps
- Still use formatting like bold, italics, strikethrough, links, tables, and more with Markdown
- Combine text styles like bold and underline, even in headings
- Markdown hides for a clean reading experience
- Use WikiLinks to connect notes and build a personal wiki or knowledge management tool
​
## GET ORGANIZED with #tags, tasks, and more
​
- Add #tags, #multi-word tags# and even #multiple/nested/tags anywhere in a note for quick organization
- Pin important tags to the top of the Sidebar
- Make important tags stand out in the Sidebar with TagCons
- Add tasks to notes and easily view all notes that include tasks
- Fold sections to get them out of the way
​
## SHARING MADE EASY
​
- Export notes to plain text, Markdown, TextBundle, Bear note, and rich text
- Export notes to HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub (Bear Pro required)
- Easily share your notes to any third-party app with the Share Sheet
​
## SEARCH FAR AND WIDE
​
- Use Spotlight to search your notes from anywhere
- Search for text inside photos and PDFs (Bear Pro required)
- Focus on specific types of notes with powerful Special Searches like @todo, @images, and @yesterday 
​
## CREATE YOUR COZY SPACE
​
* Pick from nearly 30 themes for the perfect writing space in both Light and Dark Mode (Bear Pro required)
* Choose an app icon that speaks to your personality (Bear Pro required)
* Set your own fonts for plain text, headings, and code
* Set line height and width, paragraph spacing, and more
​
## GET MORE WITH BEAR PRO
​
One subscription enables a variety of features on all your devices and keeps the Bear hugs coming.
​
- Sync notes between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac via iCloud
- Encrypt individual notes with a password that is entirely private to you
- Lock Bear with Face/Touch ID
- Export to more formats including HTML, DocX, PDF, JPG, and ePub
- Search for text inside images and PDFs in Bear notes
- Over 30 beautiful app themes & app icons
​
$2.99 monthly
$29.99 yearly
14-day free trial
​
-----
Price may vary by location. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel the subscription once activated. After purchase, manage your subscriptions in App Store Account Settings. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
-----

it.d:
Spoke: Shift Day Work Calendar

Tracking your shifts has never been easier!
With Spoke, you can see at a glance when you’re working. Suitable for your iPhone and/or iPad, the clear, easily readable calendar allows you to track your working days and hours with minimal effort – you can add or remove a shift with a single tap.

Designed with shift workers in mind, Spoke enables you to see a full month of shifts on the screen, making it easier than ever to manage your working life.

Key features:
- Color-code your shifts and assign short-names for at-a-glance insights
- Intuitive rota interface for quick rotation application
- Add multiple memos for quick reminders of each day’s events
- Shift widget enables you to see upcoming shifts without even opening the app
- Share your schedule easily with friends and family
- Sync with iCloud for real-time updates across your iPad and iPhone

Additional benefits:
- See up to two shifts per day.
- Add unlimited shifts to your calendar.
- Change your shift schedule just by tapping on the calendar.
- Copy and paste shifts for rapid diary updates.
- Add your rotation and automatically fill the calendar in a few simple steps.
- Get push notifications for shift events.
- Week number with four different patterns (1-2, 2-1, 1-52, 0-51).
- Set the start day of your week to any day.
- Email your shift events.
- Share your monthly shift view (via email/SMS/print/photo album)

The intuitive shift managing interface makes Spoke suitable for anyone who wants to take the pain out of their diary management. The app is perfect for those working random hours and days, as well as individuals working fixed shifts on rotation.

People already benefitting from Shift Days include:
- Nurses
- Doctors
- Emergency workers
- Police- Firefighters
- Military- Paramedics
- Security Guards
- Cleaners
- Bartenders

it.name: Soulver 4
it.d:
Ever reach for a calculator and the back of an envelope to work something out? That's what Soulver is for.

It's a natural-language notepad calculator: think through a problem line-by-line, using plain words and numbers. The answers appear alongside each line as you type.

Soulver isn't just a calculator app — it's the paper you'd scribble on to figure something out. Except this paper does the numbers for you, so you stay thinking at the level of your problem.

  20% of $1,480 		| $296
  $100 in EUR 			| €86
  240 km in miles 		| 149 mi
  $1,200 + 15% tax 		| $1,380
  3 weeks from today 	| June 21

Because Soulver uses sheets (like Notes), you can explore different ideas: weigh options, change variables and watch everything update.

WHAT CAN SOULVER CALCULATE?

–  Live currency conversions — 190 currencies, including crypto
–  Percentages in plain language — "20% off $50", "$50 is what % of $200"
–  Unit conversions — hundreds of units across length, weight, volume, data and more
–  Dates & time — "days until Christmas", time intervals, clock and video-timecode math
–  Time-zone conversions — "3pm New York to London"
–  Sums & averages
–  Financial functions — compound interest, mortgage repayments, hourly rates

It's the closest thing to an on-device universal calculator ever created.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE

–  A meticulously designed numeric keyboard that makes calculating fast
–  Six specialised accessory keyboards — for currencies, percentages, dates & times, and variables
–  Build your own custom keyboard with the buttons you reach for most

BEST-IN-CLASS ON IPAD

–  Multiple windows, Slide Over & Split View — float Soulver alongside Notes or Safari
–  Full Magic Keyboard support with dozens of keyboard shortcuts
–  Scribble & Apple Pencil
–  Find & replace, a line-styling palette and a powerful text editor
–  Automation with URL schemes & Siri Shortcuts

POWER USER FEATURES

–  Multi-word variables — "total cost = $750"
–  Inline tokenized references to previous answers
–  Subtotals, tags & trip planning
–  Wolfram|Alpha integration
–  Headings, comments, labels & dividers to structure long sheets
–  Custom units and global variables in the definition sheet

SHARING & SYNC

–  Sync your sheets with Soulver 4 for Mac via iCloud
–  Export to PDF & plain text, or send beautiful HTML emails
–  Share a calculation as an image — just take a screenshot

ONE TIME PURCHASE

Soulver is a one-time (non-subscription) purchase.

We've been refining and improving Soulver since 2005, and major paid updates average once every 7 years.

Try it free for 60 days, no commitment, no automatic charge.

Summary AI makes meetings more productive by automatically recording, transcribing, and summarizing conversations. Whether it’s a business meeting, interview, classroom lecture, or podcast, Summary AI captures everything clearly so you can stay present and focus.

With one tap, the app records audio, generates accurate transcripts with speaker labels, and creates easy-to-read summaries. You can even ask questions like, “What were the key action items from the marketing strategy session?” and get instant answers, thanks to built-in AI.

Why Use Summary AI?

Take and share professional meeting notes effortlessly

Record and transcribe interviews, lectures, webinars, and podcasts

Generate captions for people with hearing impairments or quiet audio environments

Who Uses Summary AI?

Professionals: Capture meeting notes, action items, and client discussions

Students: Record and review lectures, study groups, and seminars

Journalists & Researchers: Transcribe interviews with precision

Everyone: From voice memos to webinars, it handles it all

Key Features

One-Tap Recording
Start recording instantly and stay focused. Summary AI takes care of the rest.

Unlimited Recording Time
Record as much as you need, no time limits, no interruptions.

Records in the Background or with Screen Locked
Keep recording while your phone is locked or you're using other apps. Perfect for discreet, uninterrupted sessions.

Accurate Transcription with Speaker Labels
Transcripts that make sense, clearly labeled, searchable, and easy to review.

AI-Powered Summaries & Key Points
Don’t just get a transcript, get the big picture with bullet-pointed summaries.

Smart Search & Timestamp Jumping
Type a keyword, jump straight to that moment in the recording.

Ask Questions About the Conversation
Get instant answers from the AI like “Who was assigned the budget review?”

Automatic Punctuation, Capitalization & Line Breaks
Clean, easy-to-read transcripts without any manual formatting.

Boost Your Productivity

Save time reviewing meetings, just skim the summary

Stay present in conversations, not distracted by note-taking

Export notes to PDF, share with teams, or save for personal reference

Never lose a detail, everything is searchable

Your recordings and notes are private, always. Summary AI prioritizes security, and your data is never shared with third parties.

Unleash your inner car hero with Carly!

It works for Audi, BMW, Ford, Lexus, Mercedes, Mini, Opel, Porsche, Renault, Seat, Skoda, Toyota, VW, and almost all other car brands with an OBD2 port.

As every car is unique, which specific Carly features are available will vary with every model, build year, hardware, and software.

————

BASIC FEATURES INCLUDED IN THE (FREE) BASIC PACKAGE

Diagnostics (OBD), Live Data (OBD), and Emission Check (OBD) enable you to have control over the most important systems — engine and transmission.

ADVANCED FEATURES INCLUDED IN THE PREMIUM PACKAGE (YEARLY LICENSE)

• UNDERSTAND YOUR CAR'S HEALTH
With Carly Diagnostics, you can read and clear fault codes from all built-in electronic control units (ECUs), including engine, transmission, ABS, airbag, and multimedia, keep track of your car’s health, gauge the severity of problems, and more.

• POWERCHARGE YOUR REPAIR SKILLS
Get expert repair guides for your specific issues to help you understand and fix the issues by yourself.

• MONITOR ENGINE LIVE DATA
Live parameters or live data can help you take the guesswork out of understanding what your car needs and narrow down the fault causes.

• PERFORM CAR MAINTENANCE INDEPENDENT OF THE WORKSHOP
The Carly Maintenance feature helps you step-by-step to service your car yourself, reset your service and keep track of your service intervals directly from your phone.

• VIEW THE CONDITION OF YOUR BATTERY
The Carly Battery Check function helps you monitor the status of your car's starter battery, which will help to increase your batterie lifetime.

• CODE AND UNLOCK HIDDEN FEATURES
Access hidden features set by the manufacturer and customize your car to fit your needs. This feature is only available on certain car brands/models, and the coding options vary between each control unit.

• DETECT MILEAGE MANIPULATION
Mileage manipulation is on the rise. Don’t get tricked when buying a used car — use Carly to perform a used car inspection before buying.

————

HOW IT WORKS

Step 1: Check which features are available for your car model
Step 2: Order your Carly Universal Scanner
Step 3: Plug the scanner into the OBD2 port and log in on this app

THE CARLY UNIVERSAL SCANNER — THE MOST ADVANCED OBD DEVICE

The OBD2 device was designed to support almost all car brands with an OBD2 port and to enable advanced Carly features. The scanner comes with:
• A lifetime warranty
• Premium customer support

Take the health of your car into your own hands!

————

Fix grammar, spelling, and punctuation with AI proofreading tools.

it.name: FileBrowser Professional
it.d:
Professional document management for iOS, with bulk rename, backup and sync tasks. Edit your documents in-place, stream your media files and connect to over 20 different network and cloud storage locations.

“Maximize the potential of what you can do with files on iOS” - Cult of Mac
“FileBrowser remains the best option” - MacStories

Direct and secure file access to your computers, servers and other storage devices on home or company networks.

Core Features
- Access file servers and cloud storage
- View documents and optionally store them for offline viewing
- Present a video, PowerPoint or Keynote direct from the server
- Copy and move between any type of storage, from single files to whole directories
- Bi-directional automatic sync of network folders to your iPad/iPhone
- Backup local files to a network file server or cloud storage
- Integrates with other apps allowing you to edit, save and share files while on the go
- Integrates with your existing infrastructure, including Active Directory
- Integrates with iOS data protection, utilising hardware-based encryption to secure content
- Pro photographer XMP sidecar file support for rating images
- VPN on-demand support for third-party VPN clients
- Supports Microsoft Distributed File System (DFS)
- Requires no additional software on company servers

Office App Integration
- No more duplication of documents between apps
- Launch an Office app to edit a network document in-place
- Changes are automatically saved to the original document
- Scan documents or images direct to multi page PDF
- Automatic colour and perspective correction of scanned documents

MDM Integration
- Centralised distribution of FileBrowser configuration settings
- Enforced security lockdown
- Conform to corporate Mobile Security Policies
- Prevent users from changing local settings
- Selectively override any local configuration setting
- Distribute file server connection details
- Control whether offline viewing/storage is permitted
- Control whether content can be shared

FileBrowser Professional uses the SMB1, SMB2, and SMB3 network access protocols (also known as CIFS or Windows File Sharing) to connect to:
- Macs
- PCs
- NAS drives
- Windows File Servers (including Windows Server Clusters)

Access local storage
- USB Drives
- SD Cards
- Folders of other apps
- iCloud Drive folders of other apps
- iOS Photo Library

You can also connect to the following cloud storage
- Microsoft OneDrive
- Microsoft OneDrive for Business
- Microsoft SharePoint 2013 or later
- Box.com
- Google Drive (including Shared Team Drives)
- Dropbox (including Dropbox for Business)
- Backblaze B2
- Amazon S3
- Nextcloud
- pCloud
- Digital Ocean S3
- FileBase S3
- Google Cloud S3
- iDrive Cloud S3
- Storj S3
- Wasabi S3
- WebDAV servers
- FTP/FTPS servers
- SFTP servers

Unlike other file manager apps, we never gather any of your data. We also don't require you to create an account or register an email address with us.

For fast friendly support please email support@stratospherix.com. We are happy to receive support emails in any language, but are only able to reply in English.

You organize your tasks. Then everything falls apart. NoteCircle is built for when nothing sticks—and trusted by over 1 million users worldwide, with App Store features across the US, Europe, and Asia.

Why most to-do apps don’t stick
You start motivated, but after a few days everything falls apart again. Tasks get buried, routines break, and important things slip through the cracks. NoteCircle solves this by giving you structure without clutter.

One clear system for your day and week
NoteCircle brings tasks, routines, events, and checklists into one clean planner, so nothing is hidden in separate apps or screens. With a calm weekly view, you always know what needs attention today and what can wait.

Especially helpful when focus is a challenge
Many users say NoteCircle works especially well for people who struggle with focus, consistency, or feeling overwhelmed. Reviews often mention that it helps ADHD-style brains stay on track by keeping everything visible and structured in one place.

Plan faster when motivation is low
When typing feels like friction, NoteCircle removes it. Add tasks using voice input, or turn photos of notes and handwritten lists into editable tasks automatically. Capture ideas quickly and organize them later.

Build routines that actually last
Create weekly recurring routines that fit your real life, not a perfect schedule. NoteCircle helps you stay consistent without pressure, making habits easier to maintain over time.

See progress, not just tasks
Review your completed tasks, routines, and events in a clear monthly overview. Visual insights help you understand your patterns and improve productivity over time.

Never miss what matters
Manage birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and important events alongside your tasks. Sync Apple Calendar and Google Calendar to keep all your schedules in one place.

Clean and intuitive design
Designed to reduce distraction with a calm, paper-like interface. Optimized for both iPhone and iPad so planning feels natural anytime, anywhere.

Pricing
NoteCircle is free to download and use. Upgrade to NoteCircle Premium to unlock advanced features and get the most out of your planning.

Teleprompt Like a Pro
Teleprompter.com helps you easily read and deliver scripts without missing a beat. Compatible with iPhone, iPad, and Mac, it offers smooth script scrolling, easy video recording, and flawless live streaming, all from one intuitive app.

Script Management Made Easy
- Write and edit scripts directly within the app
- Import TXT, Word, and PDF scripts from your favorite cloud services
- Store unlimited scripts securely within the app
- Automatically generate subtitles from your scripts


Advanced Teleprompting Controls
- VoiceGlide voice-activated scrolling — the text follows your voice, pauses when you pause, and picks up where you left off
- Adjustable scrolling speed for manual control
- Timed scrolling for precise delivery
- Rephrase tricky lines instantly with AI-powered assistance
- Customize fonts, including accessible fonts like Lexend and Open Dyslexic
- Resize text to keep your eyes focused on the camera
- Vertical and horizontal mirroring options
- Countdown timer before scrolling starts
- Remaining script time indicator to clearly track how much time is left

Record and Edit Your Videos
- Record high-quality videos directly in the app
- Seamlessly switch between front and rear cameras during recordings
- Pause and resume recordings without hassle

Boost Your Visual Appeal
- Replace backgrounds with custom images or videos

Live Streaming Made Easy

Remote Control
- Use another device with the Teleprompter.com app to control playback and see the screen from the remote remotely
- Works online and offline as well
- Edit your scripts from the remote and do not touch the device in the teleprompter rig
- Additional remote options: Apple Watch, Bluetooth keyboards, presentation remotes, game controllers, MIDI controllers, and foot pedals

Enhanced Accessibility & Integration
- Optimized support for right-to-left languages (Hebrew, Arabic, and more)
- Connect to DockKit-supported gimbals for stable, professional-grade videos
- External USB microphone support on compatible devices for exceptional audio quality
- Customize margins to suit any teleprompter setup perfectly


Easy Sign-In & Customization
- Quick sign-in across devices (including Sign in with Apple and Google)
- Customizable app icons and quick launch from your lock screen with iOS 18

- Short videos for social updates

- Testimonials and interviews

About this app

Everything you love about WhatsApp plus built-in tools for business
WhatsApp Business is a free-to-download app with built-in tools to help you work smarter, build trust, and grow your business. 

You get  free calls* and free international messaging* plus business features to help you do more with conversations.

Download the app to get business benefits like these:

• Work smarter. Save time by letting the app do the work for you! Send customers automated quick replies and away messages so you never miss an opportunity. Use labels to quickly organize, filter, and find important conversations. Create a status to share an offer or news, and even take orders and payments** in-app to create a great customer experience. 


• Build relationships and trust. With a professional business profile on a secure platform,  you build credibility and trust with customers. Use the app to provide more responsive customer support and build long-term loyalty. Subscribe to Meta Verified*** to reinforce your authenticity.


• Sell more and grow. Get discovered, advertise, and make more valuable customer connections. Boost sales by sending targeted offers to customers; create ads that click to WhatsApp; showcase your product catalog; and give customers the convenience of in-app orders and payments.**

FAQs
Are all features free?
The app is free to download and use, with a mix of free and paid features.

Can I still use my personal WhatsApp?
Yes! As long as you have two different phone numbers, your business and personal accounts can live together on a single device.  

Can I transfer over my chat history?
Yes. When you set up the WhatsApp Business app, you can restore a backup from your WhatsApp account to transfer your messages, media, and contacts to your business account.

How many devices can I connect?
You can have a total of five web-based devices or mobile phones on your account (up to 10 if you subscribe to Meta Verified***). 

*Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.
**Not available in all markets
***Available soon globally

Major update: The new Digitize tool lets you scan handwritten notes and whiteboards into editable, searchable documents that look digitally created. Currently available in beta.

Adobe Scan is free to download and turns your mobile device into a powerful PDF and document scanner that helps you create, save, and organize your paper documents as digital files.

6 WAYS TO USE ADOBE SCAN
1) Save time with a fast document scanner: Use High-speed scan to bulk scan documents and turn stacks into PDFs in seconds.

2) Clean up scans with Magic eraser: Auto-detect and remove thumbs, shadows, stains and creases so your document scans look clear and professional.

3) Make a PDF with your phone: Convert paper documents or printed images into PDFs or JPEGs with the mobile PDF and photo scanner.

4) Use the Extract pages tool to choose the pages you need from any multi-page scan and save them as a new PDF.

5) Turn images to text: Use the image-to-text feature to make words in your scans searchable and editable with OCR.

6) Scan anything: Receipts, IDs, notes, recipes, photos, business cards, whiteboards – scan documents into PDF or JPEG files you can work with on your phone, tablet, or computer.

CAPTURE WITH PRECISION
• The Straighten tool fixes pages that come out curved or tilted while you scan, even if all four corners aren’t visible in the scan.
• Advanced scanning technology detects borders, sharpens content, and makes your scans editable and searchable.

ENHANCE YOUR SCANS
• Edit in text lets you scan words, and handwritten text, to make it editable.
• The Modify tool helps you crop, rotate, resize, and adjust colors in your scans.
• Reorder pages and preview before saving.
• Adjust the brightness and contrast of your scans in just a few taps.

ORGANIZE YOUR DOCUMENTS
• Scan paperwork and create custom folders for work documents, personal files, school forms, or ID scans.
• Contact details are pulled straight from business cards so you can save them to your phone contacts in seconds.
• Scans are automatically saved to Adobe Document Cloud for instant access and sharing.
• Set a password to keep that important scan secure while you send it.

SMART LIBRARY
• This powerful doc scanner finds documents and receipts in your photo library and turns them into PDFs.
• Touch up scans or photos directly from your camera roll.

REUSE & SHARE
• Open PDFs directly in Adobe Scan, without leaving the app. Then use tools like Modify, Edit, and Share.
• Make high-quality PDFs that unlock text from images – from scanned contracts to study notes – so you can copy, edit, and reuse.
• Export your scans to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint for new formats, then share.

DO MORE WITH ACROBAT READER
• Open your PDF scan in Acrobat Reader to comment, highlight, fill forms, and sign documents.
• Access and share securely across Scan, Reader, and Acrobat on web and mobile.

IN-APP PURCHASE
• Subscribe for even more scanning power. Subscriptions work across Scan and Reader mobile apps and Acrobat on the web.
• Combine scans into one file so you can take multiple scans and consolidate into one document.
• Increase OCR capacity from 5 to 100 pages so that you can find text in multiple images.

Download this free mobile scanner to convert important photos and documents into PDF and JPEG files to help you stay organized. Adobe Scan is the PDF converter trusted by millions worldwide.

Turn your iPhone into a Dumb Phone.

Dumb Phone™ lets you create your very own minimalist-style phone on iOS.

Replace colorful app icons, pesky notification badges, and anything that might give you a dopamine hit when you unlock your phone, with simple buttons to open your essential apps - and nothing more.

Key features:

• Break out of your existing habits

• Create a Minimalist Launcher
Select apps and add Dumb Phone widgets to your Home Screen to blend everything together.

• Choose your essential apps
Select apps that you frequently use, so they are a single tap away.

• Style your Home Screen
Choose from a Dark or Light minimalist style, by adjusting your wallpaper, background, text, and more, with themes.

• Adapt to Liquid Glass changes

Create launchers for leisure, work, night time, so you see the most important apps in context to your day.

Quickly switch between app launchers from the Control Center with new control center widgets that instantly change your Home Screen.

Download the Dumb Phone app today and embrace the full benefits of minimalism, and turn your iPhone into a powerful utility once more.

it.name: Scanner App: Genius Scan

Genius Scan is a document scanner app in your pocket. Quickly scan your paper documents on the go and export them as multi-page PDF files.

*** Apple App of the Week *** 20+ million users *** 1000s of small businesses ***

Place any document in front of your device’s camera: our scanner app automatically recognizes the paper against the background, crops it, and cleans up the result. You obtain a crisp, legible scan. Batch scanning lets you scan dozens of pages in a matter of seconds. Powerful tools help you organize, share, or archive your documents.

“Next time you plan to hit the road, don’t forget to download Genius Scan to make life easier for yourself and your accounting department.” - AppPicker.com

“Camera apps aren’t designed for close-up text scanning, but Genius Scan is.” - The Guardian

== KEY FEATURES == 

Smart Scanning:

- Document detection & background removal
- Distortion correction
- Shadow removal and defect cleanup
- Filters (black & white, whiteboard, photo)
- Batch scanning

PDF Creation & Editing:

- Document merging & splitting
- Multiple page PDF creation
- Photos and PDF import

Security & Privacy:

- On-device document processing
+ Face ID locking
+ PDF password encryption

Document Organization:

- Document tagging
- Metadata and content search
+ Smart document renaming (custom templates, …)
+ Backup and multi-device sync with Genius Cloud (separate subscription)

Export:

- Email
+ Box, Dropbox, Evernote, Expensify, Google Drive, iCloud Drive, OneDrive, OneNote, FTP, SugarSync, WebDAV.
+ Any WebDAV compatible service such as Citrix ShareFile, NextCloud, ownCloud, Synology, Yandex. 
+ Automatic background auto-export

OCR (Text Recognition):

+ Text extraction
+ Searchable PDF creation
+ Business card scanning & contact creation

The features denoted with [+] are available as part of a premium plan.

== ABOUT US ==

It’s in the heart of Paris, France that The Grizzly Labs develops Genius Scan. We take pride in crafting apps that help millions of users throughout the world and hold ourselves to the highest standards in terms of quality and privacy. Get in touch with us @thegrizzlylabs if you have any questions.

== PRICING & LEGAL ==

Genius Scan is free to use for as long as you want.

Should you choose to, you can subscribe to the Genius Scan Plus plan for more features. You can subscribe to Genius Cloud for backup & synchronization. In that case, Genius Scan’s store displays the duration and price of each subscription, updated at the time of purchase. Payment will be charged to iTunes account when the order is confirmed. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off no later than 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions, disable auto-renewal in the iTunes account settings.

Download the best free mobile scanner and scan your documents in a snap.

https://www.thegrizzlylabs.com/genius-scan/cloud/terms

it.name: Spark Mail: AI Email Assistant
it.d:
Manage priorities, not emails.
Spark brings every account into one inbox and automatically surfaces what matters most — so nothing slips through the cracks. Loved by millions and named "Best of the App Store" by Apple.

"It's a combination of polish, simplicity, and depth." — FastCompany
"You can create an email experience that works for you." — TechCrunch

EVERY ACCOUNT, EVERY EMAIL, IN ONE PLACE
Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, AOL, Hotmail, GMX, and any IMAP account in a single unified inbox.

STAY ORGANIZED WITH SMART INBOX
Important emails from real people rise to the top. Newsletters and notifications stay neatly grouped below, out of your way.

GET MORE DONE WITH EMAIL ESSENTIALS
Mark emails as done or set them aside for later
Mute threads you're no longer following
Schedule emails to send later — even if your device is off
Find anything fast with Smart Search and Smart Folders

PROTECT YOUR INBOX WITH GATEKEEPER
Pre-screen new senders and block unwanted contacts instantly.

PRIORITIZE WHAT MATTERS
Mark important senders so their emails always stay on top. Group emails by sender or domain to keep your inbox clean.

WRITE FASTER WITH SPARK +AI
Summarize long threads, draft replies, rephrase messages, and adjust tone. Your AI Assistant helps you clear your inbox, translate emails, and keep projects moving.

MANAGE YOUR CALENDAR AND MEETINGS
Connect your calendars to stay on top of your day in one app.

CONNECT YOUR FAVORITE TOOLS
Link Spark to Notion, Asana, Things, and 10+ integrations to act on everything in your inbox.

COLLABORATE WITH YOUR TEAM
Co-author emails and discuss in private comments
Assign messages so everyone knows who owns what
Share secure links to specific emails
Track read receipts to keep work moving

SECURE AND PRIVATE
Spark encrypts your data, runs on Google Cloud's secure infrastructure, and is fully GDPR compliant.

TRY IT FREE
Stick with our powerful free plan, or try Spark Plus or Spark Pro free for 7 days.

Download Spark and reclaim your day.

FAQ

Is Spark the best email app for managing multiple accounts?
Spark brings Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, and any IMAP account into one unified inbox, so you can manage every email in one place instead of switching between apps.

How is Spark different from Apple Mail and Gmail?
Spark helps you focus on what matters, not just read email. It automatically prioritizes messages from real people, keeps newsletters out of the way, and can summarize, draft, and follow up so less falls through the cracks.

How does Spark help with email overload?
Spark surfaces important messages first, lets you snooze emails until you're ready, and helps you reach Inbox Zero without the grind. Higher plans flag what needs attention so nothing gets missed.

Does Spark have AI features?
Yes. Spark uses AI to write faster, reply clearly, and summarize threads. On Plus, AI helps you make better inbox decisions. On Pro, it acts on your behalf — drafting, organizing, and following up.

Is Spark good for team collaboration?
Yes. Teams can share drafts, comment privately, assign messages, and manage shared inboxes — no forwarding chains. Collaboration is available on Pro.

Can I schedule emails to send later?
Yes. Schedule any email to send at the right time, or snooze incoming messages to return when you're ready.

Is Spark free?
Yes. Spark is free to download and use. Spark Plus is for professionals who want a more focused inbox; Spark Pro is for those who need Spark to handle follow-through so nothing gets missed.

Is Spark available on Mac, iPhone, and iPad?
Yes. Spark works on iOS, iPadOS and macOS, and stays in sync across all your devices.

Spark is made by Readdle.

it.name: Summarify: AI For YouTube
it.d:
Introducing Summarify - the ultimate video summarization app powered by cutting-edge AI technology. Save time and effortlessly grasp the key insights from YouTube videos with our powerful summarization capabilities. Powered by AI Chat, Summarify ensures accuracy, coherence, and convenience in every summary.

Now with over 15 different summary styles you can quickly summarize videos using simple summaries to data extraction, then export to PDF or markdown Summarify has never been more powerful!

Key Features:
- AI-Powered Summaries: Leverage the advanced language understanding of AI to generate concise and comprehensive summaries of YouTube videos.
- Ask Questions: Chat with and ask questions about YouTube videos.
- Video Searching: Search YouTube Videos for key moments then tap to play or see in transcript.
- Chapter Summaries: Summarize chapters with a tap.
- Custom Selections: Select custom parts of videos to summarize.
- Multiple Summary Styles: Customize your summaries to fit your preferences with simple, bullet points, or detailed formats. Tailor the summaries to your specific needs.
- Timestamps with Links: Seamlessly navigate through videos with precision. Each summary includes timestamps linked directly to the corresponding moments in the video, enabling effortless exploration and retrieval of specific information.
- Export in Multiple Formats: Enjoy the flexibility of exporting your video summaries in PDF, Markdown (MD), or plain text (TXT) formats. Choose the format that best suits your requirements for sharing, editing, or reference.
- Save and Sync: All summaries are saved for later and synced with iCloud for access everywhere.
- Share: Share your summaries with friends and family and get free bonus summaries as well!
- Chrome Extension: Use Summarify from anywhere!

Experience the future of video summarization with Summarify. Enhance your productivity, stay informed, and unlock knowledge like never before. Say goodbye to lengthy videos and hello to efficient content consumption. Try Summarify today and embark on a streamlined journey of video summarization powered by Advanced AI.

Note: 
Summarify requires an internet connection to summarize YouTube videos and videos to have transcripts/captions available.

Summarify is a free download and offers a limited number of free summaries on install and each week, if you would like unlimited summaries you can choose to subscribe to a monthly or yearly unlimited subscription.

Summarify has monthly and yearly subscription options available that unlock additional features. Subscriptions can be canceled at any time at least 24 hours before the next billing cycle.

Create stunning notes and professional documents effortlessly by hand, brainstorm ideas on an infinite canvas, and annotate PDFs seamlessly. Enhance your note-taking experience with intuitive pen gestures, effortlessly converting handwriting and shapes into typed text and precise forms.

MyScript Notes understands every word you write in your choice of 66 languages, and works on mobile platforms — so you can access and search your notes from any compatible device.

Enjoy 4 powerful experiences in one app:

• Create unlimited notebooks and fixed-size pages for your daily notes.
• Take freeform notes on boards — the world's most advanced endless canvas.
• Handwrite responsive documents, adding math calculations and diagrams.
• Import existing files as PDFs, ready to annotate.

Start with a 7-day free trial to get the full experience — then choose to upgrade to keep all features, or continue with a free limited version.

• Write emoji and symbols with your pen.

EDIT WITH YOUR PEN

WRITE, TYPE AND DRAW FREELY ON A BOARD

SWITCH TO A DOCUMENT FOR A RESPONSIVE EXPERIENCE

ENRICH YOUR NOTES

Featured multiple times on the App Store. 8M+ downloads. Trusted by millions worldwide.

Your meetings, lectures, ideas, and research don’t arrive in one format. Your notes shouldn’t have to either. Notewise brings together what you write, record, draw, read, and save. Capture it once, then find it again, ask about it, learn from it, and build on it.

Notewise is an AI note-taking app for iPhone and iPad with handwritten notes, audio recording and transcription, PDF annotation, documents, web sources, and AI search and chat.

■ CAPTURE EVERYTHING IN ONE NOTE

• Write, type, or handwrite notes
• Sketch ideas and diagrams on a freeform canvas
• Record meetings, lectures, conversations, and voice notes
• Import 25+ file formats, including PDFs, documents, slides, images, and more
• Add website links and bring web research into your notes
• Scan paper notes and whiteboards

Start with whatever is in front of you. Add things in any order, and keep related notes, recordings, files, and ideas together as you go.

■ SEARCH & ASK ACROSS YOUR NOTES

Search handwritten notes, typed text, audio transcripts, PDFs, documents, and images.

Ask Notewise AI about the note you’re in or across all your notes. Search the web when you need more context. Answers can cite the notes, recordings, files, and sources behind them, so you can always see where the information came from.

Search less. Pick up where you left off and keep thinking.

■ RECORD, TRANSCRIBE & ASK IN REAL TIME

Stay focused on the meeting, lecture, or conversation instead of trying to write down every word.

• Automatic transcription in 20+ languages
• Key points, decisions, and next steps
• Ask questions while a meeting or lecture is still happening
• Ask across past recordings later
• Keep audio, meeting notes, PDFs, and related documents together

Meeting notes become more than transcripts. Class notes stay useful long after the lecture ends.

■ WRITE, DRAW & ANNOTATE FREELY

Handwrite a page. Draw a diagram. Work through a problem. Mark up a PDF. Move things around until the idea makes sense.

Choose from 30+ brushes and tools — including pencil, oil paint, watercolor, highlighter, lasso, tape, shapes, tables, rulers, sticky notes, and more. Start from 20+ templates or create your own, from Cornell notes to meeting notes and custom workflows.

■ TURN NOTES INTO FLASHCARDS, QUIZZES & PODCASTS

Good notes don’t all look the same. Turn study notes, meeting notes, or research into AI notes, summaries, flashcards, quizzes, podcasts, and more — using the same material in the format that helps you most.

Summarize a recording. Ask questions about a PDF. Search handwritten notes. Find connections across different notes.

Sometimes you want AI. Sometimes you just want a blank page. Notewise gives you both.

■ FOR WORK, STUDY & RESEARCH

Use Notewise for meeting notes, lecture recording, handwritten and digital notes, voice notes, PDF annotation, research papers, brainstorming, and search across everything you save.

On iOS 27, use Siri AI to create, edit, and find information in your notes, or Visual Intelligence to surface related content from what you see.

Whether you’re building a company, studying for an exam, researching your next idea, or simply trying to remember what matters, Notewise gives your thinking one place to grow.

■ PRIVACY FIRST

Notewise is built by a small, independent team. We don’t sell your data or show ads. Your notes are encrypted, secure, and under your control.

■ TRY NOTEWISE FREE

Start with 10 free canvas notes and import your own slides and documents. Explore Notewise with a 7-day free trial, while core features remain free to use.

Write. Record. Draw. Remember.

it.name: Electrical Calculations
it.d:
Electrical Calculations is the PROFESSIONAL app for those who work with electrical systems every day: design, size and verify in just seconds, from the job site or the office. Over 200 calculations, diagrams, formulas and tables in a single app, with clear, printable PDF reports to attach to your documents.

Designed for electricians, installers, designers and surveyors, it saves you time and helps you avoid mistakes: from cable sizing to short circuit.

COMPLIANT WITH STANDARDS
Reliable results aligned with the main standards: IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), CEI (Italian Electrotechnical Committee), NEC (National Electrical Code), CEC (Canadian Electrical Code).

WHY CHOOSE IT
SAVE TIME: the calculations you'd do by hand, instantly available here.
AVOID ERRORS: verified formulas and up-to-date regulatory parameters.
PROFESSIONAL REPORTS: PDF reports ready for printing and archiving.
ALWAYS WITH YOU: over 200 tools including calculations, converters, tables and pinouts.


THE MOST USED CALCULATIONS
Cable sizing and coordination with the protective device, voltage drop, operating current, current intensity, voltage and power (active, reactive, apparent). Power factor and power factor correction. Current capacity of conductors and busbars, sizing of conduits and trunking, maximum cable length.

SHORT CIRCUIT AND PROTECTION
Short-circuit current at a point on the line, earthing system and coordination with the residual current device, cable protection against short circuit (K²S²), power loss, cable temperature, neutral current.

ELECTRIC MOTOR
Motor current, power, voltage, efficiency and power factor, slip, speed, maximum torque and full-load current. Three-phase motor connection diagrams, terminal markings. Three-phase to single-phase.

ELECTRONICS
Color and alphanumeric codes for resistors, capacitors and inductors, SMD code, LED resistor, voltage and current divider, Zener diode, battery life, resonant frequency, fuses and transformers.

CONVERSIONS
Delta-star, AWG, SWG, cross-section, length, energy, temperature, pressure, Ah/kWh, var/µF, Gauss/Tesla, RPM and many more.

RESOURCES AND TABLES
Tripping curves, cable reactance and resistivity, cable dimensions and weight, distribution systems (TT, TN, IT), IP/IK/NEMA protection ratings, ATEX marking, insulation classes, electrical symbols, ANSI device codes, plugs and sockets, IEC 60309, NEMA and EV charging connectors, SI prefixes and units of measurement, thermistors and thermocouples.

PINOUTS
Ethernet RJ-45, Ethernet with PoE, USB, HDMI, VGA, DVI, RS-232, FireWire, SATA, DisplayPort, Apple Lightning, Raspberry Pi, OBD II, XLR audio/DMX, MIDI, Jack, RCA, Thunderbolt, SD Card, SIM Card and LED.


Stop searching everywhere for formulas and tables: PUT YOUR ENTIRE ELECTRICAL LAB IN YOUR SMARTPHONE. Download Electrical Calculations and work faster, with standards-compliant results.

it.name: Yomu EBook Reader
it.d:
Yomu is an independent reader for book lovers. Yomu’s design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability and distraction-free reading.

Designed to let you focus on reading, Yomu has no unnecessary preferences. Just open a book and start reading. Yomu’s fluid layout dynamically adjusts all text properties and margins depending on your preferred styles and device, giving you an optimal reading experience.

FORMATS
Yomu supports standard ebooks without digital rights management.

Supported formats:
- EPub (.epub)
- Mobi (.mobi, .prc)
- Kindle (.azw, .azw3, .kf8)
- Comics (.cbz, .cbr)
- PDF (.pdf) 

Choose free books from publishers such as Standard Ebooks or Project Gutenberg. Download ebooks directly from your browser or copy files from other apps. Import files with iCloud Drive, iTunes File Sharing, or from Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, OPDS and Calibre.

READER
The reader's design is carefully crafted for ebooks and offers custom styles for better readability.

Choose your favorite theme font (Lato, Georgia, Lexend, OpenDyslexic, ...), reader mode (day, sepia, grey, black, ...), select a preset or custom font size, content layout (page, scroll) and many more options. All settings can be saved as your personal default for each book.

Swipe or tap to go to the next page. You can also use the book's content outline or table of contents to navigate to another chapter.

While reading EPub, Mobi and Kindle books, select text to take notes or highlight favorite sections. Create bookmarks or search inside ebooks to quickly find anything you are looking for.

LIBRARY
Organise your books in an easy to use library.

Manage your library by creating folders or tags to organize your books. Sort your collection either by title, author, series, recently read or drag and drop for a custom order.

You can edit a document's title, author, summary, cover or any other meta data. Save or export your books with all information and annotations in text, markdown or json format.

CLOUD
Yomu's Cloud Library (pro only) stores your books and annotations securely in Apple's iCloud.

Keep all your ebooks safe and at hand on whatever device. Every time you change something on one device, it's synced to all your other devices. Always have the latest version, when you start reading on your iPad and continue on your iPhone on the go.

Please note that you need to be signed in on your device with the same Apple ID on all platforms.

WIDGETS
See your recently read books or highlighted quotes.

Yomu includes widgets to quickly view and open your books and quotes. Add a widget from the gallery and choose a list from the options. Tap on an entry to continue reading where you left off.

YOMU PRO
Yomu is free to use and includes all basic features.

Every ebook format, theme or setting is available and lets you try out the unrestricted reader. However, the free version has some limitations and does not include certain features.

Upgrade to Yomu Pro to get:
- Cloud Library: Store and sync your library with Apple’s iCloud.
- Unlimited Documents: No limit on the number of documents.
- No Advertisement: Free version can display ads.

Yomu is an independent app, your purchase supports the further development.

When you buy an in-app purchase, you are doing so through Apple’s App Store and agree to their terms and conditions. Payments will be charged to the credit card of your Apple account.

SERVICE
Yomu is available for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

In contrast to other apps, Yomu does not collect or sell any personal information. And it keeps your data private.

Focus Keeper is the ultimate focus timer and Pomodoro timer designed to help you boost productivity and fight against procrastination. Whether you're a student preparing for an exam, managing ADHD, or simply trying to stay focused, this app is here to make your time management easier. By leveraging the original Pomodoro method, Focus Keeper helps you break down your tasks into manageable intervals and balance work with breaks, so you can stay on track without burning out.

With a built-in study tracker, customizable settings, and an intuitive design, Focus Keeper is ideal for those who need a reliable exam timer or just want to track their progress efficiently.

Focus Keeper: Pomodoro Timer, Exam Timer, ADHD
Pomodoro – Stay true to the original technique with 25-minute sessions followed by short breaks to keep your mind sharp.

Customizable Focus Timer – Adjust the length of your sessions, short breaks, and long breaks to suit your workflow.

Exam Timer & Study Timer – Ideal for students and professionals, the product acts as a perfect exam timer to help you easily manage study sessions.

ADHD Friendly – Tailored for those with ADHD, the app’s structured technique helps improve concentration and task completion.

Time Tracker – Track your productivity over time with insightful charts and fight against ADHD and procrastination.

Simple Interface – With a clean and intuitive design, it's easy to set up your focus timer and start working on your tasks immediately.

How Its Works?
Set Your Focus Timer & Study Timer– Choose a task and set the clock for 25 minutes.
Work Until the Rings – Stay focused on your task until the Pomodoro rings.
Take a Short Break – Enjoy a 5-minute break after each session to refresh your mind.
Long Breaks – After completing 4 focus sessions, take a longer break of 20-30 minutes to recharge.
The app automatically starts the next session, so you can stay productive without interruptions.

Who Can Benefit?
Whether you're a student needing a reliable study timer for exams, a professional managing multiple tasks, or someone who struggles with ADHD, the concentration app is the perfect tool. The app provides a structured routine, making it easier to avoid distractions and procrastination. Its built-in time tracker and customizable settings ensure that you can stay productive in any environment, from the office to the study room.

Why ?
Unlike other apps, Focus Keeper offers an original Pomodoro experience while giving you full control over how you manage your focus sessions. Whether you're using it as an exam timer, a study timer, or to manage ADHD, its versatile features and easy-to-use interface make it stand out. Track your productivity over time, customize your features, and use it as a stopwatch for specific tasks – all while avoiding procrastination and staying on task.
