it.name: Focus Tomato - Let's focus now
it.d:
## App Of The Day - Apple
## New Apps We Love - Apple
## Try These Out - Apple
## Student App of the Month - The App Brewery (London)



Focus Tomato is a serious tomato helping you stay focused. 
Cheer you up when you succeed.



—— Recommended consuming order ——

Step 1: Goal setting
If the goal is too big, break it down.

Step 2: only focus for 25 minutes
* Only focus on one thing
* Avoid distraction; make efforts to keep the Tomato running (ex. if someone hits you up, tell him/her getting back to you shortly!)
* Better to watch the timer counting

Step 3: Rest for 5 minutes
* Not suitable for mental consuming tasks
* Light activities that are good for your mind and body
* Pause your work momentarily can help you view things from another perspective and avoid couldn't see the forests for the trees. 

Step 4: Repeat 4 times, then take a more extended rest for 15 to 30 minutes
Repeat the previous two steps for 4 times, and take a 15 to 30 minutes long rest



—— After taking it, you can gain the following benefits on top of straight As —— 
* Prevent distracting and stay focused more easily: counting down timer brings good stress
* Reduce interruptions: postpone other tasks; most things can wait for 25 minutes
* Avoid procrastinating: when the timer is running, it means the declaration of a focused time frame
* Endure longer: with adequate rest, you can run further 



—— Features of “Focus Tomato” ——

Based on the Pomodoro method with new spice-ups and improvements.

* Do not force stop; keep the flow
Classical Promodoro clock asks you to stop working asap when time is up; Focus Tomato only notifies you with sound and does not force you to stop. You can keep staying in the zone and running the timer.

* Fractional time is allowed
Classical Promodoro clock requires to maintain 25 minutes duration. Focus Tomato freely lets you count the fractional time as long as it starts running.

* Modifiable Timeline
It is usual to forget to stop the timer. Focus Tomato allows you to modify the Timeline and make adjustments afterward.

* Do Not Disturb mode is available
Distracted by too many notifications? Do Not Disturb mode can be enabled when Focus Tomato is running.

* Integrate smoothly with other work methods and/or apps
Because the app only applies the timing part of the Promodoro technique, in addition to the original Promodoro method, you can also use the Reminder, Trello, or physical notebooks along with it.



Good tomato, why not eat it?

PDF, TXT, MS Office, iWork, HTML, pictures, music & audio-books, videos. This is what you can view in GoodReader, plus you can also annotate PDF files and edit TXT files.

it.name: one sec | screen time + focus
it.d:
Willpower is not enough against social media algorithms!

That’s why I made one sec:

one sec adds friction to distracting apps to make them less appealing…long-term!

This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies with the Max-Planck Institute, with the German and Danish government, and in dozens more scientific collaborations:

one sec has incredible effects on your screen time: app usage drops by 57% on average!

…just read our App Store reviews or try it for yourself if you don’t believe me (…you should really try it)!


How is one sec different from Screen Time limits or app blockers?
- one sec DELAYS access to distracting apps instead of blocking apps completely – that’s an important difference psychologically.
- This way, we solve the screen time problem at its roots: long-term & sustainably!
- one sec is always on, and makes using social media just slightly more annoying…so you’ll end up using it only when you actually have a reason!


Which apps can I use with one sec?
- You can set up one sec with any app you’d like to use less / more intentional.
- Most popular use-cases are: social media, games, video streaming, dating, stock/coin trading, adult content.
- Using one sec with one app of your choice if completely free, for more you’ll need to purchase one sec pro (we also need to finance development of our app!).


What if I get stuck scrolling?
- No worries, one sec offers a Doom Scroll Emergency Brake: We call it Re-Intervention.
- After a set time (e.g. 5 minutes) you’ll be kicked out of social media, and you’ll have to go through an intervention again to unlock more time.


Where can I learn more about the scientific background of one sec?
→ https://one-sec.app/research


Can I use one sec to interrupt access to websites as well?
→ Yes, one sec offers a free Safari extension as well.


How does one sec work technically?
- one sec uses Shortcuts Automation to toggle a deep breath animation whenever you open one of the configured apps (Instagram, Twitter, YouTube…).
- This breaks unconscious social media habits short-term (literally, as soon as you have set it up) and even helps long-term by adding more friction when opening these apps.


Integrations:
- Structured: one sec blocks apps during unfinished tasks.
- LENGO: learn vocabulary to unlock social media.


I developed one sec for myself in 2020…and it worked so well I decided to upload it to the App Store.

Especially for people with ADHD one sec is a great tool to gain back control for incredible focus and concentration.

– Frederik

name: SyncTasks
desc: SyncTasks IPA is the iOS installation file of a productivity app designed to help users manage tasks, to-do lists

it.name: SyncTasks
it.d:
As a daily Notion user, I found the Notion mobile app to be too cluttered and overly complicated for simple tasks management. It is also severely lacking in widget integration which is a crucial part of the iOS experience. I have tried Todoist and TickTick with Zapier, but they lacked support for all the features I needed, AND THERE IS A SUBSCRIPTION?! I wanted a simpler, more integrated solution. That's why I built SyncTasks.

Due to popular demand, I've added the option to use SyncTasks as a standalone to-do app without syncing with Notion. This can be especially useful for quickly tracking tasks like grocery lists and other on-the-go needs.

Key Features of SyncTasks:

Notion Integration: Two-way sync with your Notion databases. This feature also allows you to sync databases from multiple Notion Workspaces.

Apple Reminders Integration: Two-way sync with your Apple Reminders.

Minimal Task List Widget: My favorite feature! Inspired by dumb phones, this minimalist widget blends seamlessly with your wallpaper to create a distraction-free interface reminiscent of a dumb phone. Your home screen will display only your tasks, with no other distractions, so you can stay focused and get as much done as possible.

Stay Organized: I've decided to go back to basics and stick with the trusty folder system to help you group your tasks and stay organized. You can also quickly filter and search through your tasks to find exactly what you need.

Exclusive Membership Card: I absolutely love the feeling of getting something unique for myself. So, I've added this totally unnecessary but fun feature! When you first get your card after upgrading to premium (it's a one-time purchase, by the way—because I absolutely hate subscriptions), you can drag and shake it to unlock a series of randomized colors with different gradients on the card. This means your card will be unique to you and you alone. I know it's not essential, but it's kind of exciting, right?

No ads. No tracking. Transparent update: Nobody likes being tracked, and I'm no exception. I've also included a Release Notes section in the app where I'll share all the new features, major bug fixes, and improvements with you. This keeps the update process as informative and transparent as possible. I'm doing this because I genuinely want to build and grow alongside my users.

If you've encountered a similar issue with the Notion mobile app and are looking for a solution, want a way to stay focused and get things done, or just simply want to hang out, install SyncTasks and join me on this journey. I'll see you on the other side!

Stop wasting time reading slowly. FocalRead is a speed reading app and a full eBook + document reader. Import your files or articles from the web and save them to your Library, and read them with RSVP (Rapid Serial Visual Presentation) to finish books, documents and web content in a fraction of the time.

Supports PDF, EPUB, MOBI, TXT, DOCX, and AZW3 files (non-DRM only).

THE PROBLEM WITH TRADITIONAL READING

When you read normally, your eyes constantly move across lines, jump between words, and sometimes go back to re-read. That eye movement wastes time and causes fatigue. The average person reads around 200 WPM, but you can go much faster with the right technique.

HOW FOCALREAD WORKS

FocalRead displays one word at a time in a fixed position. Your eyes stay focused on a single point while words flow to you. No scanning. No constant eye movement. Just focused reading.

Normal reading: ~200 WPM
With FocalRead: 300 to 600+ WPM
Advanced readers: up to 900 WPM

That’s up to 3x faster than traditional reading.

REAL TIME SAVINGS

A typical 90,000-word book takes 7.5 hours at normal speed. At 600 WPM, you can finish in about 2.5 hours. That’s 5 hours saved on a single book.

IMPORT AND READ YOUR FILES

Use FocalRead as your daily reader. Import and keep everything inside the app:

PDF documents
EPUB eBooks*
MOBI books*
TXT files
DOCX documents
AZW3 files*

*only if they are not DRM-protected

You can also paste text from anywhere or read articles from the web.

A READER BUILT FOR ORGANIZATION

Save all books and documents to your Library
Rename and organize your content
Track progress and pick up where you left off
Chapter navigation for EPUB books
Reading history and sessions

CUSTOMIZE YOUR READING EXPERIENCE

Adjust speed from 100 to 1000+ WPM
Choose standard, lowercase, or UPPERCASE text
Select your preferred font style
Smooth progress tracking while you read

PERFECT FOR

Students reading textbooks and study materials
Professionals reviewing reports and documents
Book lovers who want to read more
Anyone who wants more learning in less time
Start reading faster today with FocalRead.

it.name: one sec | screen time + focus
it.d:
Stop opening social media on autopilot. one sec adds a short pause before distracting apps so you can choose what deserves your attention.

This principle works really well: we have gained scientific evidence in numerous research studies with the Max-Planck Institute, with the German and Danish government, and in dozens more scientific collaborations:

one sec has incredible effects on your screen time: app usage drops by 57% on average!

…just read our App Store reviews or try it for yourself if you don’t believe me (…you should really try it)!


How is one sec different from Screen Time limits or app blockers?
- one sec DELAYS access to distracting apps instead of blocking apps completely – that’s an important difference psychologically.
- This way, we solve the screen time problem at its roots: long-term & sustainably!
- one sec is always on, and makes using social media just slightly more annoying…so you’ll end up using it only when you actually have a reason!


Which apps can I use with one sec?
- You can set up one sec with any app you’d like to use less / more intentional.
- Most popular use-cases are: social media, games, video streaming, dating, stock/coin trading, adult content.
- Using one sec with one app of your choice is completely free, for more you’ll need to purchase one sec pro (we also need to finance development of our app!).


What if I get stuck scrolling?
- No worries, one sec offers a Doom Scroll Emergency Brake: We call it Re-Intervention.
- After a set time (e.g. 5 minutes) you’ll be kicked out of social media, and you’ll have to go through an intervention again to unlock more time.


Where can I learn more about the scientific background of one sec?
→ https://one-sec.app/research


Can I use one sec to interrupt access to websites as well?
→ Yes, one sec offers a free Safari extension as well.


How does one sec work technically?
- one sec uses Shortcuts Automation to toggle a deep breath animation whenever you open one of the configured apps (Instagram, Twitter, YouTube…).
- This breaks unconscious social media habits short-term (literally, as soon as you have set it up) and even helps long-term by adding more friction when opening these apps.


Integrations:
- Structured: one sec blocks apps during unfinished tasks.
- LENGO: learn vocabulary to unlock social media.


I developed one sec for myself in 2020…and it worked so well I decided to upload it to the App Store.

Especially for people with ADHD one sec is a great tool to gain back control for incredible focus and concentration.

– Frederik

one sec is covered by U.S. Patent 12,468,828 B2.

it.name: Routinist - Schedule Planner
it.d:
Routinist helps you achieve goals and build habits by scheduling time for them as part of your everyday routines. 

***WHY***

I built Routinist because I got tired of having excuses for why I wasn’t taking action on my goals: I don’t have time... I’m too tired… I forgot… etc. Routinist eliminates these excuses for me.

Becoming a better you is hard. It requires motivation, planning, commitment and execution. Only you can keep yourself motivated and committed over the long term. The purpose of Routinist is to help with the planning and execution parts, so you can improve your health, achieve your goals, and continue becoming a better you.

***HOW***

Step 1: List your typical morning routine actions and estimate time for each action. This can be super simple (get ready for day for 45 mins), or as detailed as you like (floss 1m, brush 3m , shower 10m, shave 5m, etc.).

Step 2: Enter your desired sleep and Go Time (the time you need to leave for work).

Step 3: Add new actions (those small steps towards your goals like flossing or exercising) and their estimated time, and insert them into your routine.

Routinist uses this info to remind you when to wake up and go to bed so you have time for your routines and get the sleep you need. Take action during the time you most control: your mornings and evenings. Routinist removes the ‘when’ so you can focus on the ‘what’.

***WHAT***

• Build morning (and evening!) routines
• Wake up and bed time reminders
• Understand your time constraints and prioritize
• Reduce decision fatigue
• Routines sync with your Apple Calendar!
• Optimize your routine: tweak the time, order and frequency of actions for any routine any time (yes – even during an active routine)
• Complete actions, skip actions, and undo skip/complete as needed
• Continuously updated routine completion times
• Timers & notifications for each action
• Apple Watch! Complete, Skip, Pause & Resume from the notifications on the Apple Watch or iPhone notification center
• Flexibility: schedule actions on certain days each week or every x days, x weekdays, etc.
• Progress Tracking for a birds eye view of your progress
• Detailed History of every routine 
• Dark Mode
• 120+ action ideas with suggested times

***WHO***

You.

Routinist is probably very different from any other app you’ve tried, and it takes some getting used to. But I strongly believe this unique approach to achieving your goals will make your life better.

“Anyone can list out their goals, but they will be quickly abandoned without the help of an app like this… No other goal app compares to Routinist. Worth the time to learn.”

“This app enabled me to establish a regular morning routine for the first time in my 45 years of life.”

“If you have different times for leaving to work/school everyday but similar morning tasks this is perfect. It is worth the time to try it.”

"Your app has enormous potential in helping others reach theirs."

***WHEN***

Now!

# Taio

A modern app for text processing on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, provides seamless experience for clipboard, markdown editing and text workflows.

Taio supports Universal Purchase, pay once to use on iPhone, iPad and Mac devices.

## Main Features

### Clipboard

Taio takes clipboard data as one of the input sources, you can capture it quickly for *temporary* use. Saved records can be synchronized across your iOS devices using iCloud, we also provide beautiful home screen widgets for better experience.

### Editor

Taio provides a full-fledged **Markdown** editor, it supports `CommonMark` and `GitHub Flavored` standards. Instead of telling you everything, we would like to highlight some great stuff here:

- Full text search, in-document search
- Built-in image uploading
- Focus mode
- Multi-Tab editing
- Multiple color themes
- Toolbar for beginners
- Outline view
- Math formulas and diagrams
- Tags, wikilinks and backlinks
- Export to multiple formats
- Dynamic text in snippets
- Open file system that can be accessed by other apps
- Syntax highlighting for common programming languages

There are more interesting features we cannot cover here, please try it out!

### Actions

Text actions in Taio is a powerful mechanism to provide extensibility for both **clipboard** and **editor**, it works the same as the `Shortcuts` app.

You can build your own workflows using several action blocks, with support for variables and control flows.

Furthermore, if the built-in actions don't meet your needs, you can even write action blocks using **JavaScript**. The JavaScript engine in Taio is powered by JSBox, it provides tons of API bindings to interact with iOS.

## Customer Support

Feel free to reach us out if you have any suggestions or ideas.

- Website: https://taio.app
- Email: hi@taio.app
- Twitter: @TaioApp

Not someday. ThisDay.

it.name: ThisDay: Planner & Reminders
it.d:
Not someday. ThisDay.

Most planners hand you a backlog. ThisDay hands you a day.

Every task, note, voice memo, event and habit lands on a real
date; not in a someday pile you scroll past for months. Open
the app and there is one thing in front of you: today, in the
order it happens.

ONE DAY, EVERY KIND OF THING

Tasks, events, notes, voice memos, photos and habits share one
list, because they share one day. A habit at 10:00 sits between
the 9:00 task and the 11:00 meeting, where it belongs. Same row,
same swipe, same checkbox, whatever kind of thing it is.

Your own calendars appear inline too, at the hour they happen,
so a morning with a meeting in it never looks free.

EVERYTHING CAN REMIND YOU

Record a voice memo and put a reminder on it. Write a note and
have it find you at 6pm. Your phone can already take a voice
memo, it just can't tell you about it later. ThisDay can.

HABITS THAT TICK THEMSELVES

Point a habit at Apple Health and stop reporting on yourself.
Steps, exercise minutes, active energy, sleep, the Watch's three
rings, and workouts from running to yoga. Set the number you're
aiming at; ThisDay watches for it and fills the ring as your day
fills it.

ThisDay only reads Health, never writes to it, and only the
measurement each habit names. Nothing leaves your device.

And a habit is never marked done because a sensor said so and
you disagreed. No reading is ever "done"; if your watch was on
the charger, the tick is still yours to make. Your tick always
wins.

APPLE REMINDERS, BOTH WAYS

The Reminders lists you choose show up in your day, next to
everything else, read-only: ThisDay never edits somebody else's
row. And when you ask for it, the other direction. Tasks you
make here are written back out as reminders, so they reach Siri,
a Mac that doesn't run ThisDay, and anyone you share a list
with. Switching it off takes the copies back out.

NOTHING GETS BURIED

Unfinished work follows you to today instead of quietly aging on
a date you've already passed. Completed things can leave the
list or stay in a folded section, your call.

ONE RULER, FROM A DAY TO THE YEAR

Slide the ruler at the top of your day out to a few days, the week, the month or the whole year, and tap any day to come back into it. The + is always one thumb away.

ALSO IN HERE

• Quick capture for every kind of item
• Reminders, repeats and rollover
• Categories, priorities and links
• SiriAI: ask about your plans, answered on your device (Apple Intelligence)
• A Library for notes, voice notes, pictures, places and countdowns
• An inbox for anything without a day yet
• Monthly recaps and medals you can share
• Widgets, Live Activities and an Apple Watch app
• Shortcuts and Siri
• Twelve languages, every screen in each one
• Light and dark, and an accent you choose
• Your day on iPhone, iPad, iPhone Duo and Mac

BUILT BY ONE PERSON

There is no account and no sign-up, because there is no server
to sign up to. No analytics, no tracking, and nothing sold to
anyone; your day never leaves your device.

Something broken or missing? Write to hello@akilastudio.com and
you'll get a reply from the person who made it.

FREE FOR TASKS, ONE PRICE FOR THE REST

ThisDay is free for 21 days with everything included; no card up front and nothing to cancel. After that, tasks and repeats stay free for good. ThisDay Pro opens everything else with one payment. No subscription, no renewal.

ThisDay is on the Mac too, in this same App Store listing, with its own one-time unlock. If you bought ThisDay on iPhone, the Mac costs less.

To-dos live in little notebooks right next to the main timeline. To set a due date, just drag a to-do and drop it on a date. You also get to customise your books with a pre-set book cover, or even a photo from your camera roll.

it.name: ADHD Schedule Planner: Weel
it.d:
Time is a slippery thing—but with the Weel ADHD planner, it's all under control. Weel transforms your daily schedule into a clear, single image, using an intuitive 24-hour analog watchface that provides a full-circle view of your time. This unique feature is especially helpful for people with ADHD, dyscalculia, or time blindness. Even if you're neurotypical, the Weel ADHD planner offers a refreshing, visual way to manage time effectively!

Whether you’re juggling tasks, working across time zones, or avoiding last-minute scrambles, Weel’s design helps everyone stay organized and on track.

Key Features of Weel ADHD Planner:
• Stay on top of your schedule: The 24-hour analog watchface allows you to see your entire day at a glance, helping you focus on upcoming tasks and avoid losing track of time before important events.
• Plan ahead: Attach notes or checklists to events so you remember exactly what to prepare for meetings or appointments.
• Factor in travel time: The Weel ADHD planner helps you account for travel between events, so you avoid scheduling conflicts and always arrive on time.
• Manage time zones easily: Simplify scheduling for international meetings or travel plans without the confusion.
• Customizable for your needs: Weel is highly configurable, allowing you to tailor the app to your own preferences and organize your day your way.
• Widgets & Apple Watch compatibility: With customizable widgets and Apple Watch integration, Weel helps you visualize your entire day with the power of its unique 24-hour watchface.

Looking for More? Try Weel+ ADHD Planner
Weel+ enhances your scheduling with advanced tools for even smoother time management. Try a free 7-day trial to unlock features like additional calendars, recurring events, and more.

With Weel+ ADHD planner, you can:
• Add multiple calendars: Keep personal, work, and family schedules separate but accessible in one app.
• Create repeating events: Set daily, weekly, or custom recurring events to never miss commitments.
• Apply travel time to recurring events: Keep your schedule running smoothly throughout the day.
• Get priority support: By subscribing to Weel+, you help support our team and receive priority assistance.
Weel+ ADHD Planner Subscription Information:
• Available in Monthly and Yearly options.
• Your iTunes account will be charged at the end of your free trial if you choose to continue.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings on the App Store.

Why Weel ADHD Planner is Different:
Weel ADHD planner is more than a calendar—it's a comprehensive time-management tool designed for inclusivity. Traditional apps give a linear view of time, but Weel uses a 24-hour analog watchface to visually structure your day. This circular design makes it easier for people with ADHD or neurodivergent needs to understand and manage their time.

Weel makes your schedule tangible and easy to grasp, offering a clearer picture of your responsibilities. And, while it's great for ADHD, it’s also powerful for anyone who wants a smarter way to manage their time.

Perfect for Everyone:
Whether you’re a professional juggling meetings, a parent managing your family’s activities, or a student balancing school and social life, Weel ADHD planner makes time management simpler. Its visual approach helps anyone manage their time better. Available on iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, Weel ensures you’re always connected to your schedule.

Stay Organized with Weel ADHD Planner:
Weel is your all-in-one solution for time management. Its 24-hour analog watchface and flexible customization make it a fresh, visual, and easy-to-use app. Upgrade to Weel+ for advanced scheduling features and support our development team.

AI-POWERED FEATURES TO REVOLUTIONIZE YOUR INBOX

INDUSTRY-LEADING FREE EMAIL STORAGE

TOP-NOTCH SECURITY and PRIVACY

Addons supports seamless usage across all Apple platforms, allowing for data synchronization between iPhone, iPad, and iMac devices.

This feature is very powerful and can give your Safari unlimited possibilities.

Resource sniffing is another standout feature of Addons. It supports automatically merging and converting m3u8 files to mp4. It also supports background playback and export of videos, allowing you to enjoy high-definition movies anytime, anywhere.

【Customized Ad Filter】
Addons not only helps you block annoying ads, but also speeds up webpage browsing and provides a better user experience. Similar to AdGuard and Adblock Plus, Addons' custom rule function allows you to control ad blocking accuracy more flexibly, meeting your personalized needs.

【Tagit Mode】
The ad filtering feature allows you to get rid of annoying ads while browsing web pages. Addons supports tagit mode, which allows you to remove web page ads while retaining useful content, making your browsing experience more pure and comfortable.

【Smart Search】
The smart search feature allows you to quickly switch Safari search engines by using [trigger word + space + keyword]. You don't need to manually change settings multiple times; it can be done with just one click.

【Web Dark Mode】
Finally, Addons also supports webpage dark mode, helping you better protect your eyes and avoid the frustration of overly strong white light at night.

In summary, Addons is a feature-rich and easy-to-use Safari extension that allows you to customize your Safari with more functionality and useful tools, giving your Safari unlimited possibilities! Come and experience it now!

E-SIGN ON THE GO

- Explore a multitude of tools to make your documents stand out.

SNAP TO PERFECTION

OCR—TURN PHOTOS INTO TEXT
The Optical Character Recognition (OCR) feature transforms photos into editable text. This is a perfect tool for converting photos of text into usable content. Try the picture scanner feature today!

DESIGN TOOLS
Documa comes loaded with intuitive design and markup tools:
- Draw, highlight, redact, or clean up documents to convey your ideas clearly.
- Change fonts and colors, add form elements, and make your document look polished and professional.

DOWNLOAD NOW
Don’t let paperwork slow you down. Download Documa now and revolutionize the way you handle documents. More than a pdf scanner app, it’s a comprehensive document management solution ready to make your life easier, whether you're filling out tomorrow’s homework or signing your next business contract.

Here’s how Flipd helps improve your productivity & concentration, and reduces procrastination:

CUSTOM PRODUCTIVITY TIMERS
• Improve concentration with custom productivity timers
• Keep track of the time you’re putting toward a certain subject or activity
• Add #tags for each activity

STATS & INSIGHTS

CHALLENGE & COMPETE

LIVE FEED & STUDY ROOMS

OTHER FEATURES

it.d:
## Featured by App Store in 150+ Countries & Regions
# Hot This Week
# Apps We Love Right Now
# Big Apps From Small Teams
# New Apps, Features, and Content

## What People Are Saying

"A simple, but valuable utility for creating timed focus sessions of productivity." - MacStories
"Focused Work helps you stay on track better than ever" - iMore
"Focused Work makes it easy to create and manage Focused Sessions." - 9to5Mac
"A tool that helps overcome that first step." - Knapsack

Focused Work is a powerful timer that helps you focus and be productive.

It's purpose-built for people who want to focus for long periods and struggle with this.

Add structure to your day with "Focus Sessions" that encourage you to complete goals, tasks, and help you divide your time into Focus, Break, and Prepare stages.

Pick from a selection of templates, including a simple timer, Pomodoro - inspired by the Pomodoro Technique, Flowmodoro - inspired by the Flowtime Technique, and other various sessions.

You can also create repeatable sessions specifically tailored to your needs. Add stages, set time limits, and much more.

Ultimately, Focused Work helps you be more accountable by reminding you to focus, reflect, and build healthy productivity habits by completing various daily goals.


**Core Features**

· A simple, powerful timer that keeps you on-task
Choose what to focus on. Start the timer. Get stuff done!

· Curated Basic Sessions to get started
Run a Pomodoro session, Flowmodoro session, or even just a simple timer

· Create Focus Sessions
Tailor them to your needs with a plethora of configurable options

· Reminders
Be reminded to stay focused, when to take breaks, and also to start a focus session!

· Reflection
Track what went well for you during your focus session and what you can improve upon

· Scratch Pad
Jot down thoughts that come to mind during your session and return to them after

· Daily Goals
Completing your daily focus goals earns you a streak and helps you form healthy productivity habits

· Statistics & Charts
Review recent productivity across the past week, month, and year

· Block Distractions
Select apps and websites you want to restrict access to during a session

· In-app Shortcuts Automation
Automatically perform actions as you progress through your session, such as turning on Focus

· Link with Toggl Track
Explore advanced time tracking by linking with Toggl to create time entries, assign projects and tags

· Productivity Export
Export completed sessions in CSV format


**iOS & iPadOS Features**

Focused Work is available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, with extensive support for each platform;

· Live Activities
Control your session from the Lock Screen or Dynamic Island

· Interactive Widgets
Control your session, view daily goals, and start a session from the Home Screen

· Control Center Widgets
Start a session or access the Scratch Pad with Control Widgets

· StandBy
Interact with your session while iPhone is in StandBy

· Spotlight Search
Quick start and interact with sessions from search

· Focus Filters
Filter which sessions can be viewed & started based on the active Focus

· App Shortcuts & Siri
Start and interact with a session via various shortcuts that can also be linked together

· Picture-in-Picture
Show a floating timer above other apps with Picture-in-Picture mode

· Session Alerts on all devices
Start a session on one device and receive update alerts on others with Focused Work installed

· iCloud Syncing
Sync productivity stats & created sessions between devices

· Privacy Focused
Your data is securely stored and managed via iCloud. No account registration.

· And much more
Mac Support, Share Sheet controls, App Icons, Keyboard Shortcuts, VoiceOver, Split View & Slide Over, Low Power Mode, Drag & Drop, Dark Mode, URL Schemes


If you have any questions, please reach out to focusedworkapp@michaeltigas.com.au

it.name: neurolist: AI Planner for ADHD
it.d:
neurolist is an AI-based planner that helps neurodivergent folks reach their potential.

First, you enter a scary task and the app automatically estimates how long it will take and assigns it to a category. Then you can use the "magic subtasks" button to turn the task into a manageable list of steps. The best part? You can even add context about your life, which our AI will use to generate even better tasks.

neurolist also helps you stay present by only showing you one to-do at a time. No more overwhelming lists.

Any to do you create you can get back with one easy tap via the task library. Ultimate flexibility.

To help you actually do your to-do's, neurolist has a smart timer, which lets you complete each task like a playlist, with a timer for each subtask. Then it dynamically estimates how long it will take to complete, while notifying you via voice notifications along the way. Perfect to avoid ADHD procrastination.

This is just the beginning: In the future neurolist will allow you to give more context on each task and will provide advanced productivity analytics.

Using the proven Pomodoro Technique, Plantie transforms your study sessions into a fun, rewarding experience:

- Set a focus timer (10-180 minutes)

- Stay in the app to watch your plant grow
- Leave the app? Your plant withers!
- Complete sessions to harvest plants & earn coins
- Build your own virtual garden of productivity!

NEW IN VERSION 3.0

- Sunflower - Bright and cheerful for sunny study days
- Mushroom - Perfect for late-night study sessions
- Bonsai - For those seeking zen-like focus
- Plus 12+ other plants including Apple, Orange, Cherry, Cactus & more!

PERFECT FOR STUDENTS

- Beat Phone Addiction: Our unique "plant withering" system creates real accountability
- Study Timer: Customizable Pomodoro sessions from 10 minutes to 3 hours
- Focus Mode: Blocks distracting apps while you study
- Study Statistics: Track your daily, weekly & monthly progress
- Motivation Rewards: Earn coins to unlock new plants & features

KEY FEATURES

[Comprehensive Statistics]
- Visual charts showing your focus patterns
- Daily/weekly/monthly study time tracking
- Identify your most productive hours

- 15+ unique plants to collect

- Coin rewards based on focus duration
- Achievement badges for milestones

[Global Community]
- Available in 18+ languages
- Join millions of focused students worldwide
- Share your garden progress with friends
- Compete in focus challenges

[Smart Features]
- Background notifications when tasks complete
- Widget support for quick access
- Adjustable white noise & nature sounds
- Dark mode for late-night studying
- Battery-efficient design

WHY STUDENTS LOVE PLANTIE

"Finally, an app that actually helps me study! The fear of killing my plant keeps me off Instagram." 
- Sarah, Medical Student

"I've tried every focus app, but Plantie's the only one that stuck. My GPA went up by 0.5 this semester!" 
- Mike, Engineering Major

"The plants are so cute! I've collected them all and my study habits have never been better." 
- Emma, Psychology Student

SCIENCE-BACKED APPROACH

Plantie combines three proven productivity techniques:
1. Pomodoro Technique: Structured work/break intervals
2. Gamification: Rewards and progress visualization
3. Negative Reinforcement: Plant withering prevents phone checking

FREE TO START

- No subscription required
- Core features completely free
- Optional ads for bonus coins
- Premium upgrade removes all ads

TECHNICAL EXCELLENCE

- Optimized for all iPhone models
- Dynamic Island support
- Minimal battery usage
- Offline functionality
- Regular updates & new plants

JOIN THE PLANTIE FAMILY

Whether you're preparing for exams, working on assignments, or just trying to read without distractions, Plantie is your perfect study companion. 

Download now and discover why students call it "the app that saved my grades!"

Start growing your focus forest today!

Questions? Suggestions?

it.name: Timesheet tasks: Time Deposit
it.d:
Introducing TimeDeposit – the ultimate productivity app for busy professionals! With TimeDeposit, you can easily track your work task times, see logs of your sessions, and access detailed stats and project overviews - all in one convenient place.

Say goodbye to saving work times into an excel - the app synchronises data between your Apple devices; even with watchOS, making it easier than ever to keep track of your tasks on-the-go.

Whether you're a freelancer, student, consulting, or simply looking to optimize your workday, TimeDeposit has everything you need to stay on top of your tasks and achieve your goals. Try it today and discover how it can transform the way you work!


FEATURES

• Track your task times
Create tasks and track times by starting a task session.

• Group tasks in projects
You can group multiple tasks into a project to organize your work, times or billing.

• Manual entries
If you forgot to track a task, you can create a session later. If you remember it while your are on it, create a started log.

• Stats
Get an overview of project task times with stats, top tasks and top projects.

• Calendar view 
See your daily logs in a calendar. Add external calendar events (synced in your device) as task sessions in the app easily.

• Archive tasks
Having tons of tasks can difficult starting a session. Archive the completed tasks to hide them. You won't lose any information.

• Generate reports
Get monthly, weekly or custom time range reports of your total task times for each project. Export the results as CSV, text or image.

• Synchronized and secure
Automatic synchronization of the data between all your Apple devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch) thanks to iCloud. Your current task session will also synchronize.

• Live Activities
Stay updated of the current task session elapsed time with Live Activities on your notifications center (or dynamic island) on your iPhone and iPad.

• Apple Watch widgets
Add a shortcut to open the watch app on your work face, or a widget to keep track of the current task session elapsed time.
Start and stop sessions directly from your Apple Watch.

• MacOS menu bar app
Keep a timer of your current task session in your menu bar. Start quick sessions from the menu.


FAQ

~ Is it free?
It is a freemium app. You are offered 25 tasks for free so you can try the app to the fullest. You can upgrade the app to have infinite task creation with a single lifetime purchase, no subscriptions!!

~ Why paying?
I created the app as a solo indie developer and each purchase helps me creating new updates and helpful features. Also, it is priced as 2 coffees and you won’t ever need to pay again.

~ What if I lose connection?
No worries! All of your data is stored in the device until it can be synced with the rest of your devices.

~ I found a bug / I want to request a feature.
Please send an email to contact@timedeposit.app

it.name: UTM Virtual Machines
it.d:
UTM lets you run Windows® 11, Ubuntu®, or macOS fully virtualized with maximum performance. Run Windows® 7, Windows® XP, and other older operating system emulated with decent performance. Try out the new experimental 3D driver for DirectX® graphics support allowing you to run Windows® games on your Mac!

UTM uses the popular QEMU system emulator securely in a sandboxed environment to protect your data from viruses and malware in the emulated operating system.

Designed for macOS using the latest and greatest Apple technologies, UTM is built from the ground up with the Mac in mind.

Features:

 • Run ARM64 operating systems such as Windows® for ARM and Ubuntu® ARM on your Apple Silicon Mac fully virtualized at near native speeds
 • Run Intel/AMD operating system such as Windows® 7, Windows® XP, Ubuntu® Linux, and more (emulated with limited performance on Apple Silicon Macs, fully virtualized on Intel Macs)
 • Run macOS 12 or higher in a virtualized environment
 • Run Intel applications on Linux with Rosetta(*)
 • Over 30 processors can be emulated by the QEMU backend including i386, x64, ARM32, ARM64, MIPS, PPC, and RISC-V for developers and enthusiasts
 • Supports macOS Sandbox to protect your data from any viruses or malware infecting the emulated operating system (such as Windows®)
 • GUI display mode, terminal console mode, and headless mode (with support for multiple displays)
 • Attach USB devices to your virtual machine
 • Experimental: GPU accelerated OpenGL+Vulkan on Linux VMs and DirectX® on Windows® VMs
 • Bridged and shared networking support
 • Run and store VMs from external drives
 * Snapshot management for saved states
 • Don't know how to use QEMU? Confused at all the options QEMU provides? UTM provides an easy to understand UI for creating and configuring VMs that does not require knowledge of QEMU command line arguments

Current Limitations:

We are working hard to provide new features. Below are some things currently missing from UTM. We hope to support at least some of these features in the future.

 • No direct mounting of external disks and drives, only mounting disk images is supported
 • No drag & drop of files and data, only copy paste of text and sharing of a single directory is supported with tools installed
 • Experimental GPU acceleration is still under active development and there may be compatibility issues with many games

(*) Linux with Rosetta is only supported on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 and up.

it.d:
About this app

Everything you love about WhatsApp plus built-in tools for business
WhatsApp Business is a free-to-download app with built-in tools to help you work smarter, build trust, and grow your business. 

You get  free calls* and free international messaging* plus business features to help you do more with conversations.

Download the app to get business benefits like these:

• Work smarter. Save time by letting the app do the work for you! Send customers automated quick replies and away messages so you never miss an opportunity. Use labels to quickly organize, filter, and find important conversations. Create a status to share an offer or news, and even take orders and payments** in-app to create a great customer experience. 


• Build relationships and trust. With a professional business profile on a secure platform,  you build credibility and trust with customers. Use the app to provide more responsive customer support and build long-term loyalty. Subscribe to Meta Verified*** to reinforce your authenticity.


• Sell more and grow. Get discovered, advertise, and make more valuable customer connections. Boost sales by sending targeted offers to customers; create ads that click to WhatsApp; showcase your product catalog; and give customers the convenience of in-app orders and payments.**

FAQs
Are all features free?
The app is free to download and use, with a mix of free and paid features.

Can I still use my personal WhatsApp?
Yes! As long as you have two different phone numbers, your business and personal accounts can live together on a single device.  

Can I transfer over my chat history?
Yes. When you set up the WhatsApp Business app, you can restore a backup from your WhatsApp account to transfer your messages, media, and contacts to your business account.

How many devices can I connect?
You can have a total of five web-based devices or mobile phones on your account (up to 10 if you subscribe to Meta Verified***). 

*Data charges may apply. Contact your provider for details.
**Not available in all markets
***Available soon globally

 Learn more about messaging privately: https://www.whatsapp.com/privacy

Walnote is your AI-powered solution to learn faster, retain more, and make studying fun. Key Features of Walnote: 

AI Video Summary & Transcription 
Transform YouTube videos and podcasts into accurate, concise summaries. Get video transcripts with a click and easily search for important points.

Audio Record & Transcription Record your own lectures or notes and instantly transcribe them with AI-powered transcription. You can also upload audio or video files for transcription, making it perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who needs to capture audio or video information. 

Interactive Flashcards & Quizzes
Take your learning to the next level by creating flashcards and quizzes based on video summaries and transcriptions. Reinforce what you've learned and track your progress. 

Customizable Notes 
Edit, organize, and refine your video summaries and transcripts. Add personal notes, highlights, and translations for a tailored learning experience. 

Save Time, Learn Smarter 
Cut through the clutter and get straight to the essence of any video or audio with AI-driven summaries. Maximize your productivity and focus on what matters most.

Boost Retention 
Use flashcards and quizzes to improve memory retention and understanding. Turn passive listening into active learning.

Why Walnote? 
AI-Powered Accuracy Leverage the latest AI technology to generate accurate, reliable transcriptions and summaries in seconds. 

User-Friendly Interface 
Designed for simplicity and ease of use. Navigate through your notes, summaries, and quizzes effortlessly. 

Versatile Learning Tool 
Whether you're studying for exams, researching, or keeping up with podcasts, Walnote is the ultimate tool for efficient learning. 

Upgrade Your Learning Experience Today! 
Download Walnote now and transform how you learn from videos, podcasts, and audio recordings. Say goodbye to information overload and hello to smarter studying.
